text.ACTION: Entry One: April 6, 2009 (Note: I'm posting the entry dates as they're given, despite this journal apparently having been written in the future. There are several other quirks like this in later entries, as well, though we'll look at those when we get to them.)

Entry Two: April 7, 2009 (Note: Despite the date on the entry, the events depicted here will occur over April 6 and 7, 2009. For those readers unfamiliar with Livejournal, users are able to post their own emoticons. I have taken the liberty of converting RB90's to standard Something Awful emoticons for ease of use.)
Current Music: None, apparently  (watch the video in the last entry! I thought my mp3 player broke...but it's okay now, thankfully)

Minato, and this is my very first entry...first real one, I guess. Stupid journal. I don't really know what to write about in these things...I'm only doing this because a friend from my old school asked me to. No idea why she didn't just have me get a Myspace, or why she insisted on making the account and picking the username for me, but she said I have to use this one so I guess I should get used to it. She'll probably read this eventually, so, uh...hi?  Girls are weird.
"Ramenboi?" And "1990" isn't even my birth year...

Anyway, today was my first day at my new school, Gekkoukan High. It was interesting, I guess. I met a few new people and all that. I'm more interested in what happened last night before I got to the dorm where I'm staying...but I don't know how to put it into words, really. I'm not much of a writer...I guess if you're interested you could just watch the animation I made about it. It's in the last entry. After you do that, you might wanna watch another animation I made about it...
Arrival in the Dark (Sorry about the name, I just thought it sounded cool.  )

I really think most of this was a dream...maybe I had too much soda before bed? I drew some pictures of what happened afterwards, too. (Note: RB90 tends to transcribe his experiences verbatim in his Livejournal, which may seem unusual to some readers. I believe he does this because of an earlier experience in his life that resulted in repressed memory - this experience and the associated phenomenon are described in further detail in later entries.)
This is Mitsuru, she pretty much runs things around the dorm where I'm staying. She's kind of a scary ice queen chick.

text.Yukari: Who's he?

text.Mitsuru: He's a transfer student. It was a last minute decision to assign him here. He'll eventually be moved to a room in the boys' dorm.

text.Yukari: ... Is it okay for him to be here?

text.Mitsuru: I guess we'll see ...
She'll be a junior this spring, just like you.

text.ACTION: This is Yukari. She really does have a gun, but you can't really see it here. I decided not to bring it up right away...I want to at least try to fit in here, y'know? Maybe there's some kind of toy gun fad here? Maybe she's just a freak. So I just said it was nice to meet her.

text.Yukari: Nice to meet you, too ...

text.Mitsuru: It's getting late, so you should get some rest. Your room is on the second floor, at the end of the hallway. Your things should already be there.

text.Yukari: Oh ... I'll show you the way. Follow me.

text.ACTION: I'm not sure how much this has to do with the picture, but I'm really not all that thrilled about living in a girls' dorm. Not that I don't like girls, I guess I'm just not all that smooth. Also I apparently go by "Ramenboy1990". I'm sure that'll get me all the ladies. Hopefully the transfer to the boys' dorm will go through soon too, though I don't know if I'll get along with them any better
I guess I need to think positive, huh...

text.Yukari: Pretty easy to remember, huh? ... Since it's right at the end of the hall. Oh yeah, make sure you don't lose your key, or you'll never hear the end of it ...

text.ACTION: She asked if I had any questions, and the one that was eating at my mind was who exactly that kid with the contract was. Seemed like he'd been playing too much GTA or something. I read somewhere that that fucked kids up.
Aaaand she didn't have any idea what I was talking about. I knew sleeping on the bus before the subway ride to the dorm was a bad idea. Now she thinks I'm crazy.  I'm already off to a great start...
Well, no, everything turned green and bloody and coffin-y, but I can't tell her that when she already thinks I'm seeing creepy little kids in the dorm. So I played dumb.

text.Yukari: You know what I-- ... nevermind. It seems like you're alright. Well, I'd better get going ... um ... I'm sure you have other questions, but let's save them for later, okay? Good night.

text.ACTION: Well, yeah, like that question about the whole gun thing. But whatever. I hit the sack pretty soon after that. Figured I was seeing things because I was tired.
I woke up the next morning to Yukari pounding away on my door like crazy. I have a Bullet for my Valentine alarm clock, y'know...anyway, I let her in.

text.Yukari: Mitsuru-senpai asked me to take you to school. It's getting late, so are you ready to go?

text.ACTION: I told her I was, and we were off. We had to take the monorail to school...it might be kinda stupid, but this was my first time riding a monorail, so I made an animation about it. It's right here:
First Day of Class (I couldn't think of a cool name for it, sorry  )

text.Yukari: You should go see your homeroom teacher first. The Faculty Office is right there to the left ... and that concludes the tour. Do you have any questions before I go?

text.ACTION: I went ahead and asked her what class she was in...I figured it would be nice to have someone I at least kind of knew in my class.

text.Yukari: Me? I dunno ... I haven't looked at the classroom assignments yet. Hey ... about last night, don't tell anyone what you saw, okay? ... See ya later!

text.ACTION: (It's kinda stupid to put a caption that there's many people in front of the board when I could've just drew it, huh? I'm tired, give me a break.)
I talked to a few of the kids around the board before I took a look at it...

text.Male Student: There's no need for them to post the names of the kids who are gonna be in our class ... I mean we'll never see them again after we graduate anyways.

text.Female Student: Oh, great ... I have the worst teacher ever ...

text.ACTION: ...and it wasn't really all that exciting, so I went up to check which class I was in.
Doesn't it figure mine's not on there? I checked again, just in case...
...and got lucky for the first time in my life. Thank god.

So now anyone from school who reads my journal knows: I am in Class F. That is me with the black hair. Say hi...if you want. It'd be nice, I guess. After that, I looked around a bit and headed for the Faculty Office...

...as we see in this fascinating drawing. Art doesn't always have to be about exciting subjects, you know. And everything you draw is practice, so there's no reason not to do it. It's my journal, anyway, I can post what I want, so there.
This is my Composition teacher, Ms. Toriumi.

text.Ms. Toriumi: Minato Arisato ... 11th grade, correct? Wow, you've lived in a lot of different places ... Let's see, in 1999 ... that was what, ten years ago? Your parents ...

text.ACTION: What a bitch. I really wish she hadn't brought that up. I don't even like to think about it.

text.Ms. Toriumi: I'm sorry ... I've been so busy, I didn't have time to read this beforehand. I'm Ms. Toriumi. I teach Composition. Welcome to our school. Have you seen the classroom assignments? You're in 2-F; that's my class. But first, we need to go to the auditorium. The Welcoming Ceremony will be starting soon. Follow me.

text.ACTION: So I did, and we went to the auditorium, and the Principal gave a really, really boring speech about trying your best or something. Give me a break.
Some guy asked me a question during the assembly...

text.Some Guy: You came to school with Yukari this morning, right? I saw you two walking together. Hey, I have a question. Do you know if she has a boyfriend?

text.ACTION: How the fuck was I supposed to know? Geez, I just got here. I was nice when I told him I had no idea, at least, so score one for level thinking.

text.Some Guy: I see. I thought you might know, but ... I guess not. ... So how well do you know her?

text.ACTION: I was actually kinda thankful this teacher came along and bitched us out, since it made that guy stop interrogating me about a chick I just met. Anyway, school was school (boring as hell, in other words) but more stuff happened afterwards.
This guy just came right up and started acting like he was my best buddy in the world. What the hell?
I had no idea who he was and said so.
So yeah, this is Junpei. He seems pretty dopey, but I guess he's alright.

text.Junpei: I transferred here when I was in 8th grade. I know how tough it is bein' the new kid ... So I wanted to say "hey." ... See what a nice guy I am?!

text.ACTION: Yukari's in our class, too, and she showed up right around then.

text.Junpei: I didn't think we'd be in the same class again.

text.Yukari: At it again, huh? I swear, you'll talk to anyone if they'll listen. Did you ever think you might be bothering someone?

text.Junpei: What? But, I was just bein' friendly ...

text.Yukari: If you say so. Anyway, looks like we're in the same homeroom. Funny, huh?

text.Junpei: Um, hello? Are you forgetting that I'm in this class too?
What's up with that? C'mon, gimme the dirt!

text.Yukari: Wh-what are you talking about?! We live in the same dorm. There's nothing going on, okay?! Why are people even talking about it?! Now you have me worried ...

text.ACTION: She asked me about last night again. I still have no idea why she's so worried about it, and it's really just making me more suspicious.

text.Yukari: Seriously, don't say anything about last night, alright?

W-wait a minute! Don't get the wrong idea! Listen! I just met him yesterday, and there's absolutely nothing between us! Geez ... I've gotta go. I've got something to take care of for the archery team. But you better not start any rumors!

text.ACTION: She took off, and left me feeling like shit. I don't see why it'd be such a big deal...then again, I DO have a pretty stupid Livejournal username. Maybe girls can smell that kind of thing.
I guess Junpei's not really that bad, though.

text.Junpei: She's so paranoid. But, hey! It's your first day here, and people are already talkin' about you! Believe it or not, she's actually pretty popular! You da man! Heheh, this is gonna be a fun year. I can feel it!

text.ACTION: I'm "da man"? Well, whatever. He took off too, and I headed home, where I'm working on this entry now. A little more happened, but I'm fried, so I'll wrap things up tomorrow. "Da man" is going to bed.
Coming up in the next entry: More of the same...or is it? We call that a "teaser".
Entry Three: April 17, 2009 (This is an intentional time skip; like many bloggers, RB90 does not update on a daily basis, but will summarize several days' events in one update.)
Current Mood:  I have no idea.
Current Music: I'm too...something to listen to music right now.

Minato here. Uh...I don't really know how to explain any of this. You might notice my journal is on friends only for the time being...and that I don't have any friends yet, so it's not like anyone can see this. That's probably for the best. Have you ever drank one of those convenience store slushies and gotten brain freeze? My whole body feels like that right now. It sucks.
I guess I can best explain what's up if I start with the boring stuff and move up in excitement from there, kinda like the Matrix movies backwards. Let's see...

Okay, so I don't think I've mentioned this in my journal yet, but ever since I was little I've had really weird dreams about people I know. Like...what they do when I'm not around. When I wake up, I'll draw pictures about it...though I kinda do that with everything else too. Anyway, I dreamt about Mitsuru and someone new...

I didn't find this out until later, but this is Akihiko. He's a senior, a boxer, and a total prep. Just look at that vest thing he wears. Prep. I don't know if I like him all that much, but then again it's not like that matters right now. I'll explain why later.

text.Akihiko: There's a lot going on.

text.ACTION: Okay, this Apathy Syndrome stuff is scary. Apparently people will just suddenly...I don't know, stop giving a shit. About everything. They just sit there and drool on themselves, and there's nothing you can do to snap them out of it. Nobody knows why it happens, and it could happen to anyone at any time.

text.Mitsuru: I've seen it on the news quite often lately. They say it's due to stress, but ...

text.Akihiko: Yeah, right. It has to be THEM. Otherwise, it's not worth my time ...

text.Mitsuru: You have a one track mind ... will you be okay on your own? The Chairman will be here for the next few days, but after that, I can ...

text.Akihiko: Don't worry. I'm just getting a little practice.

text.Mitsuru: This isn't a game, Akihiko ...

text.ACTION: So yeah, that's that. I don't have any proof or anything that's what they were talking about, or even if they talked at all, but it seems as real as the rest of what's going on.
Anyway, the next day I overheard a conversation on the way to class.

text.Other girl: N-no! Not that one! I mean the story about the first-year student! Not only did she stop coming to school, she does nothing but sit and stare at the walls all day. If her mother tries to talk to her, she only mutters to herself, "It's coming! It's coming!"

text.ACTION: You got it; it's that Apathy Syndrome again. It's all over the goddamn place these days.
In Composition, Ms. Toriumi was going on about her favorite authors. I have to admit I wasn't really paying attention...
...but I was paying a lot more attention than Junpei, apparently.
I helped him out, though, if only because he said I was "Da Man". I guess I'm too nice sometimes.
It's not like I got credit for answering the question, since it wasn't mine to answer...

...but it was the cool thing to do, right? I'd rather not sabotage my chances at fitting in on my second day. I've even held back on wearing my From Autumn To Ashes tour shirts. You should be proud of me, internet journal.
I headed home after class to find Yukari and an adult chatting in the living room.
This is Mr. Ikutsuki. He's...well, he's...
...he's kinda like that. Mostly harmless, I think.

text.Ikutsuki: I apologize about the confusion regarding your accommodations. However, it may take a while longer before you receive the proper room assignment. Is there anything you'd like to ask?

text.ACTION: First, I asked why he was here; he's the Chairman after all, you'd think he'd be busy or something.

text.Ikutsuki: To welcome you, of course! Well, to be honest, I do have other business here. Speaking of which ... where's Mitsuru, Yukari?

text.Yukari: She's upstairs.

text.Ikutsuki: As dilligent as always. Although it doesn't hurt to come down and say hello ... is there anything else?

text.ACTION: I asked about who else was living here, since it was a pretty big dorm but I'd only met Yukari and Mitsuru.

text.Ikutsuki: There are only four students in this dorm: Yourself, Yukari here, Mitsuru, and a senior named Akihiko Sanada. I hope you all get along.

text.ACTION: I was finished asking questions, so I mentioned heading off to bed.
Somehow, I doubted Yukari. Anyway, that night I had another dream...
Ikutsuki, Mitsuru, and Yukari were in some sort of control room, watching a console that I was displayed on.

text.Ikutsuki: So, how's he doing?

text.Mitsuru: He went to bed a little while ago. He's asleep now. Mr. Chairman, do you think he's ... ?

text.Ikutsuki: Well, let's wait and see for now ... the Dark Hour is approaching.

text.ACTION: The Dark Hour...somehow, I think I had an idea of what it was just from hearing about it. It lead me to make this animation:
I tend to leap from drawing pictures into animating, so excuse that, nonexistent readers.

text.Yukari: Then, he must be ...

text.Ikutsuki: As you can see, he's retained his human form. He's asleep, but he's definitely experiencing the Dark Hour. The only question that remains or not is whether he has the Potential. Although, he must ... if he didn't, they would've preyed on him by now.

text.Yukari: Scary ...

text.Ikutsuki: In any case, we should continue to monitor him for a few more days.

text.Mitsuru: Yes sir.

text.Yukari: I feel kinda bad though, spying on him like this ...

text.ACTION: All of a sudden, I had some kind of vision of a door opening and filling my brain with light. I meant to animate it, but never got around to it. Oh well. Inside the door was what seemed like a huge elevator coated in velvet...
This is Igor. I guess he's an imaginary friend or something, since I only ever see him in dreams. I wonder why my imaginary friend is a creepy old man...Freud would have a field day with me.

text.Igor: This is Elizabeth. She's a resident here, like myself.

text.ACTION: This is Elizabeth, my other imaginary friend. I think she's meant to be Igor's "assistant", but I've never seen her do much to help him. Maybe I'm overanalyzing my own dreams.

text.Igor: It's been years since we've had a guest.

text.ACTION: All of a sudden, the contract I had signed showed up on the table between Igor and I.

text.Igor: Only those who have signed the Contract can enter this place. Henceforth, you will be welcome here in the Velvet Room. You are destined to hone your unique ability, and you will require my help to do so. I only ask one thing in return ... that you abide by the Contract, and assume responsibility for the choices you make.

text.ACTION: I felt myself stirring from sleep, but before I awoke, Igor handed me a blue velvet key and bid me farewell.
(There I go again with the needless captions.)
I didn't notice any sort of key on me when I woke up, so I set all of that aside and headed off to school.
Junpei caught me on the way in. That guy really needs to lay off the sugar.

text.Junpei: The sky is blue ... we're young ... what more could we ask for?! Dude, listen to this ... oh, wait! I'm not supposed to say anything ... sorry, man.

text.ACTION: Weirdo. The bell rung right after that.

You notice how my journal is now named "My Life is a Goddamn Mess"? The past few days gave me more than enough reasons to pick that name, not least of which is Mr. Ekoda, who appears to be some kind of samurophile.

text.Mr. Ekoda: I'll be teaching you about good old Japan all year. Some people say Classic Lit isn't relative to everyday life, but oh how they're wrong! Hey, are you all listening to me ... ?

text.ACTION: Long story short, no. No, I was not. But I stayed up regardless, since I knew this would be on the test. I didn't listen, don't get me wrong, but I think I absorbed his blathering like some kind of sponge with cubic trousers.
Nothing much happened for the rest of the day, so I hit the sack almost right away after I got home. I had another dream...
...and I think this one took place during the Dark Hour. Well, it did, as I found out later, but we'll get to that.
It was Ikutsuki, Mitsuru, and Yukari again in the control room. I wish I had normal dreams, like sugary birds make of candy knocking people off chocolate platforms or something.

text.Mitsuru: The same as last night.

text.Ikutsuki: Hmm, very interesting ... even those who have the Potential tend to be unstable at first. Memory loss, disorientation ... but this subject is rather unique. He hasn't exhibited any of the common symptoms.

text.Yukari: But ... we're treating him like a guinea pig.

text.Ikutsuki: I understand your concern, but it's imperative that we recruit new members. I heard he's your classmate ... wouldn't you be more comfortable working with someone from the same grade?

text.Yukari: Yeah, I guess, but still ...

text.ACTION: Suddenly, there was a beeping out of nowhere.

text.Mitsuru: ... Is that you, Akihiko?

text.ACTION: I guess it was some kind of communications device. ...that or just a cell phone.

text.Akihiko: Unfortunately, I don't have time to talk ... it's chasing me. I wanted to let you guys know. I'm almost there ...

text.Yukari: Does that mean ... he's bringing that thing here?!

text.Mitsuru: Mr. Chairman!

text.ACTION: "Battle"? You've got to be kidding me, I thought. We're high school students, the only battles we fight are with finals.
Back at the front door, Akihiko wasn't doing so hot.

text.Akihiko: Get ready to be surprised ... It'll be here any second.

text.Mitsuru: This is no time to joke around! Mr. Chairman, please head for the command room! Takeba, go upstairs and wake him up! Then escape out the back!

text.Yukari: But what about you two?

text.Mitsuru: We'll stop it here. You led it to us, Akihiko, so I'm afraid you'll have to fight.

text.Akihiko: Like I had a choice!

text.ACTION: Okay, here's where things get weird. I actually woke up, and...well, all of this shit was still happening. This is right around when my life started to become an official goddamn mess.
I agreed, since I was too tired and shocked to really do anything else.

text.Yukari: Hurry! Downstairs! We'll leave through the back door! ... Wait! Take this, just in case.

text.ACTION: She was just carrying a fucking sword around! And gave it to me for some reason! It was a real goddamn sword, too, not like those things those Akihabara nerds are always waving around. I figured I wouldn't look a gift horse in the mouth, so instead of talking about it we headed downstairs as fast as we could.
Turns out we weren't safe at all, as we discovered when Mitsuru gave us a call.

text.Mitsuru: Takeba, do you read me?!

text.Yukari: Y-yes! I hear you!

text.Mitsuru: Be careful! There's more than one enemy! The one we're fighting isn't the one Akihiko saw!

text.Yukari: What?!

text.ACTION: Then something nearly bashed the damn door down, so...
We made it to the roof entrance and headed out, and, well, that's when things started getting really weird. I animated what happened next:
Don't ask me to explain it. And don't accuse me of lying, because it's what really happened. I swear. I made another animation, too:

At the same time, I think I'm still dreaming, you know that? I'm pretty sure that I'm dreaming about writing a journal entry about this shit. Maybe I'm crazy. Yukari told me that after all this, I decided it was naptime...
I dreamt again. Maybe I dreamt while I was still dreaming, and I'm dreaming now. That's a dream within a dream within a dream.
Man, I'm glad nobody can read this.

text.Igor: You became unconscious after awakening to your "Power". It's nothing to worry about, though. So just relax. By the way ... I see it was Orpheus who heeded your calling.

text.ACTION: "Persona". Igor told me about it. It's like a protective mask that everyone wears. We all have many faces we show to the world, and our Persona is but one of many.
And to think, yesterday I was fretting about my crappy journal username.

Igor said that a Persona grows more powerful as its wielder, the Persona user, develops their Social Links. Friendships, relationships, and the like. The closer you get to people, the more powerful your Persona becomes.
For some reason I could see this whole Social Link thing not going too well for me. I wonder if online dating counts.
After Igor and I had our chat, I woke up to find myself in a hospital bed with Ykari standing over me.

text.Yukari: Thank goodnes, you finally came to ... how much sleep do you need?! It's been a whole week!

text.ACTION: Well, she cares if I live or die, that's gotta count for some Social Linkage or something.

text.Yukari: Oh yeah, this is Tatsumi Memorial Hospital. It's just a short walk from the station. The doctor couldn't find anything wrong with you. He said you were just exhausted. But you kept sleeping and sleeping ... you know how worried I was? Um ...
Even though I was supposed to protect you, I ... but your power, it was amazing.

text.ACTION: Hey, the creepy old man in my head was right after all! Maybe this is how kids with voices in their heads that tell them to burn things feel.
I would've called them Creepy Hand Rape Things, but I guess that doesn't have as much of a ring to it.

text.Yukari: We'll explain everything later. I'm sorry I didn't tell you before ... I, uh ... I wanted to tell you that ... I'm sorta like you.

text.ACTION: I think I've mentioned this before, but I really wish people wouldn't bring that up. Still, she was trying to be nice.

text.Yukari: To be honest, I already know about your past ... but it didn't seem fair, so I wanted you to know about mine. It was back in '99 ... there was a big explosion in the area. Supposedly, my dad died in the blast, but nobody really knows what happened. He was working in a lab run by the Kirijo Group, so I'm hoping if I stick around long enough I'll learn something. That's why I'm going to Gekkoukan High, and why I was there when this happened to you. ... And here I am telling you all this right when you woke up. While I was waiting, I thought to myself, "I've been hiding so many things from him ... and when he wakes up, I'm going to tell him the truth."

text.ACTION: Yukari took off, and I spent the rest of the day thinking about what happened. And eating tasty hospital ice cream. I should unleash the inner fury of my personality more often.
The next day, it was business as usual at school since I was doing better.

text.Yukari: Hey, sorry to hit you with this first thing in the morning, but Ikutsuki-san wants to talk to you today. Come to the 4th floor of the dorm after school today, okay? Don't forget.

text.ACTION: So I headed home right after class...

...and nobody was there. I figure they're all up waiting for me upstairs, but I wanted to blog about this in case they called the men in white coats to cart me off to the asylum or something. At this point, that'd probably be a good reaction to all the crazy shit that's been happening.
I'm gonna head upstairs now. Hopefully I'll have some answers next time I write.
Coming up in the next entry: What the hell is going on here, anyway?! Also: violence!

So it turns out that either I'm not crazy, or everyone else is just as whacko as I am. I guess that's good to know. Right after I finished blogging yesterday, I headed upstairs where everyone was waiting for me.

text.Ikutsuki: I'm glad that you're okay. The reason I asked you here is because I needed to talk to you. Please, have a seat.
I believe I mentioned him earlier, but this is Akihiko.
Okay, let me start off by asking you this ...

text.ACTION: Well, no. And that's exactly what I said.

text.Mitsuru: I'm not surprised by your reaction. However, you've already experienced this truth firsthand. Do you remember the night you came here? You had to have noticed the signs ... the streetlights went out ... nothing was working ... there were coffins everywhere ... didn't it feel like you were in a different time?

text.ACTION: So that's what that was. And here I was starting to think the sushi I had that day was bad.

text.Ikutsuki: It occurs each night, as the clock strikes twelve. It'll happen tonight, and every night to come.

text.Akihiko: Normal people don't realize it, since they're all sleeping inside their coffins. But that's not what makes the Dark Hour so interesting. ... You saw those creatures.
They only appear during the Dark Hour, and attack anyone not in a coffin. It's our job to defeat them. ... Sounds exciting, huh?

text.ACTION: I'm not really sure how to feel about Mitsuru. At least she hasn't turned her wrath on me yet. Note to self: stay out of her way or risk emasculation.

text.Mitsuru: You just got hurt the other day!

text.Ikutsuki: Now, now. He does his work well. Long story short ...

text.ACTION: ...That is either the dumbest or most awesome thing I have ever heard. Maybe both.

text.Ikutsuki: Mitsuru is the leader. I'm the club advisor.

text.Mitsuru: A Shadow feeds on the mind of its prey; the victim becomes a living corpse. They're responsible for most of the incidents on the news, if not all of them.

text.Ikutsuki: Some may even awaken to a power that enables them to fight the Shadows. That's "Persona", the power you used the other night. The Shadows can only be defeated by Persona-users ... which means it's all up to you guys.

text.ACTION: Well...it's kind of hard to say no, especially when they just offered me a gun and a chance to join the Gekkoukan High Demon Slaying Club. So I signed up.
I guess it beats anime club.

text.Yukari: Welcome aboard!

text.Ikutsuki: Thank you so much. I'm really glad. Oh, I almost forgot, about your room assignment ... why don't you just stay here, in your current room? I don't know what the holdup is, but I guess it worked out in the end.

text.Yukari: Holdup? But wasn't that ... oh, nevermind. It doesn't matter anymore.

text.ACTION: Suddenly, my vision seemed to flicker and fade for a moment. It was kinda like that time I drank Coke while eating Pop Rocks and listening to Atreyu: intense.
So Igor wasn't kidding. Most people just ensure they won't die cold and alone by making friends...I gain superpowers and have mysterious voices tell me I did a good job. My life is a goddamn mess.
We chatted for awhile, and before long I headed off to bed. That night, during the Dark Hour...
...I found myself facing that kid from before.

text.Pharos: We've met before.

I remembered, so I thought I should tell you. The end of everything. ... But to be honest, I don't really know what it is. Oh, looks like you've awakened to your power ... and an unusual power it is. A power that takes many forms, yet is bound by none ... it may prove to be your salvation, depending on where you end up.

text.ACTION: First Igor, now you? Geez, this is like a Very Special Episode of Minato's Life.

text.Pharos: I'll be watching you, even if you forget about me ... okay then, see you later.

text.ACTION: And with that, the kid took off.
The next evening, I was enjoying some Evanescence when I heard Yukari calling me from downstairs.
There, I found her and Akihiko waiting at the door.

text.Akihiko: There's someone I wanna introduce. ... Hey, hurry up!

text.Yukari: Wait, don't tell me ...

text.Akihiko: This is Junpei Iori from Class 2-F. He'll be staying here as of today.

text.ACTION: My life is a goddamn mess.

text.Yukari: He's staying HERE? You've gotta be kidding me!

text.Akihiko: I bumped into him the other night. He has the Potential, but he just awakened to it recently. I told him about us, and he agreed to help.

text.Yukari: You have the Potential?! For real?!

text.Junpei: I don't remember much, but ... man, that's embarassing! He said that's, ya know ... completely normal in the beginning. Like bein' confused and not remembering anything. Did ya guys know that?

text.ACTION: Well, it didn't happen to me...

text.Junpei: It happens to everyone else. ... But man, I was shocked to find out about you guys. I had no idea. I'm glad I'm not the only one. It could get kinda lonely, y'know. I bet you're stoked too, right?! Havin' me join ...

text.Yukari: Huh? Uh ... y-yeah ...

text.ACTION: I guess "stoked" is one way of putting it.

text.Akihiko: I think we're about ready ...

text.Junpei: Ooh, we're gonna go do somethin'?! Sweetness!

text.Akihiko: With this many people, we can start exploring that place.

text.ACTION: Something tells me Junpei isn't going to be the brains of our lively little band.

text.Akihiko: We believe we can find the reason for the Dark Hour there.

text.Yukari: I hope so.

text.Akihiko: The Chairman will give us the details tomorrow night, so be ready.

text.Mitsuru: Come to the lounge when you get back to the dorm. I have something to tell everyone.

text.Junpei: Oh, are we having that talk?

text.Mitsuru: I'll save the details for later. See you there.

text.Yukari: She's probably busy with things like Student Council, unlike us.

text.Junpei: Whoa, Yuka-tan! Do I sense some hostility?

text.Yukari: Well, it's not that I don't like her ... she just ...

text.ACTION: That evening, we all gathered in the lounge as Mitsuru had suggested.

text.Ikutsuki: I'd like your undivided attention. For a long time, Mitsuru and Akihiko were the only Persona-users we had. But that number has recently jumped to five. Therefore ...

text.Junpei: Sorry ... I asked this yesterday, but what's this Tartarus thing again?

text.Yukari: You haven't seen it, Junpei?

text.Ikutsuki: It's no surprise, since it only appears during the Dark Hour.

text.Akihiko: Just like the Shadows ... interesting, huh? And it's the perfect place for us to train.

text.Junpei: Whoa ... their nest, huh?

text.Yukari: But, Senpai ... what about your injury?

text.Mitsuru: Since Akihiko hasn't fully recovered yet, he'll only come as far as the entrance.

text.Akihiko: ... Yeah, I know.

text.Ikutsuki: Well, I'm sure he won't complain, as long as you don't go too far in. Since we're dealing with Shadows, Tartarus isn't something we can avoid.

text.Junpei: Relax, I've got your backs.

text.ACTION: Just what I was about to say.

text.Mitsuru: What about you, Mr. Chairman?

text.Ikutsuki: I'll stay here. As you know, I can't summon a Persona ...

text.ACTION: With that, we headed off into the night...
I made an animation of what happened next! Check it out:

text.Junpei: Labyrinth ... ? What are you talking about?! What happened to our school?!

text.Mitsuru: Once the Dark Hour passes, everything returns to normal.

text.Junpei: This is the "nest" you were talking about? But, why?! Why'd our school turn into a giant tower?!

text.Yukari: I'm sure it's complicated. Who cares, anyway? it's not like it would change our minds about fighting.

text.Akihiko: Well, maybe now we'll find out. Mitsuru and I have only gone in to take a peek ... this will be our first time exploring it. Exciting, isn't it? There has to be some kind of clue in here about the Dark Hour ...
I know ... you don't have to remind me.

text.Yukari: But it sure is creepy ...

text.Mitsuru: This is only the entrance. The labyrinth lies beyond the doorway at the top of those stairs.

text.Akihiko: First, we'll have you three get a feel for the place. Why don't you go have a look around?

text.Yukari: What?! By ourselves?!

text.Mitsuru: We're not asking you to go very far, and I'll be feeding you information from here.

text.Junpei: So you two didn't plan on coming in the first place?

text.Akihiko: That's right.

text.Junpei: For real? ... One of us?

text.ACTION: I don't know what I did to merit it, but Akihiko ended up making me the leader!

text.Junpei: W-wait! Why him?! he doesn't look like a leader!

text.Yukari: But he HAS fought them before ...

text.Junpei: Seriously?

text.Akihiko: That's true, but there's another reason.

text.Junpei: Y-yeah, of course I can!

text.Yukari: I think so ...

text.Akihiko: These are Shadows we're talking about here. Without your Persona, you're toast.

text.Yukari: I'm aware of that.

text.ACTION: I was just about to lead the way upstairs, since that was apparently my job, when...
...a strange blue door caught my eye. (Captions again! Sorry!) I headed on over to it...
...and the blue velvet key from earlier was sitting in my hand somehow. I stepped inside...
...and found myself in the Velvet Room once again, with Igor and Elizabeth waiting for me.

text.Igor: The time has come for you to wield your power. The tower that you are about to venture into ... how did it come to be? For what purpose does it exist? Regrettably, you are not yet capable of answering these questions. That is why you must be made aware of the nature of your power.

And when you have defeated your enemies, you will see the faces of possibility before you. There may be times when they are difficult to grasp ... but do not fear. Seize what you have earned. Your power will grow accordingly ... be sure to keep that in mind.
But please come again of your own accord. I'll tell you then about my true role ... the manner in which I can best assist you. Until then ... farewell.

text.ACTION: With a flash of light, I found myself in the entrance to Tartarus again.

text.Junpei: Yeah, what's up? You look like a zombie. Don't tell me you just dozed off! You're like the coach who fell asleep during that championship game! Come on, man, you're s'posed to be our leader!

text.Yukari: Cut him some slack. If nothing's wrong, let's get going.

text.ACTION: Before we went inside, I took a few minutes to talk to the others about their abilities and Personae.
This is my Persona, Orpheus. I've been studying up on mythology since this whole Persona thing started, and I found out that he's apparently some kind of mythological harpist.

(Minato is unique in that he can change Personas both in and out of combat; no other character can do this, a departure from the previous Persona games. This is a good thing, too; Orpheus is terrible, "boasting" a weakness to Lightning and Darkness attacks and only learning three spells. Minato is also unique in that he can wield any kind of weapon, while the other characters are limited to one type each.

Oh, and one more thing: if Minato dies, it's game over right then and there. Even if it was from an instant death attack, which are hilariously common in this game. Even if your other characters could've revived him. The game loves to use this particular quirk against you later on.)

Junpei uses two-handed swords, apparently. I think he mentioned he's into Kendo or something, but he uses them all wrong. It's a little embarrassing, and he's not very accurate, but he does hit pretty hard when he hits.
His Persona is Hermes, the messenger of the gods.

(Junpei is the game's tank - he's there to hit people with swords, maybe throw around some Fire spells on enemies that are weak to them, and not much else. This has its good sides and bad sides: he's less likely to do stupid things than some of the more versatile characters, but he's also kind of a one trick pony. He's also hilariously weak to Wind attacks - one good gust and he's done for.)
Yukari uses bows, which makes sense, what with her being in the Archery Club and all. She's even less accurate than Junpei, but at least when she misses she doesn't fall over like he does.

You know, if your Persona is supposed to be a reflection of your true self, and Yukari's Persona is a woman chained to a giant cow skull...I guess she's pretty fucked up. She says her Persona's name is Io.

(Yukari is the game's healer. She's got powerful Wind attacks, too, but her AI leans toward healing before attacking nearly every time she's given the option. She also has an extremely high magic defense, so generally speaking she's pretty tough to kill.

Seriously, though. Giant cow skull.)
Now that I had a better idea of what my team was capable of, it was finally time to step inside.
Apparently this was "Thebel", the first block of Tartarus.

text.Junpei: So this is it, huh?

text.Yukari: I hope I don't get lost ...

text.Junpei: Whoa! Is that you, Senpai?

text.Mitsuru: I'll be providing audio backup from here on out.

text.Junpei: Wait ... ya mean you can see inside here?

text.Mitsuru: It's my Persona's ability.

text.ACTION: Yeah, apparently the inside of the tower changes place every time we enter and leave. That makes a ton of sense.

text.Yukari: Well, THAT makes me feel a whole lot better ...

text.Mitsuru: Now, based on your current location, you can expect to encounter enemies at any minute. They shouldn't be too tough, but proceed with caution. Practice makes perfect.

text.Junpei: Right!

text.Yukari: Got it. ... Why is she always like that?

text.Mitsuru: Keep in mind, these are real battles you'll be engaging in. Now, see if you can eliminate all the Shadows wandering this floor.

text.ACTION: Well, we went to work doing just that. Mitsuru took the chance to teach us a little more about fighting off the Shadows, and I took the chance later to make animations of each lesson, just in case we need a reminder later on:
Oh, another thing...every so often after we finished off some Shadows, I had a vision of some cards floating around in space. I got to pick one after they were shuffled...

...and would earn rewards for doing so, like new Personae, money, or items. The stuff just fell into my lap after I picked the right card; nobody even questioned where it came from. I guess when you hang out with a chick who has the power to summon a giant cow skull, nothing's unusual anymore.
We killed a few groups of Shadows, then Mitsuru called us up again.

text.Mitsuru: Usually, there are more Shadows on the prowl. ... Well, at least you gained some experience in battle. Let's go back to the dorm for today. There should be an Access Point somewhere on that floor. You can use it to return to the entrance. Since there aren't any enemies to worry about, why don't you split up and search for it individually?

text.ACTION: That's exactly what we did, and before long...
It warped us right back to the entrance of Tartarus.

text.Mitsuru: So, how was it?

text.ACTION: I was honest with her: it was a piece of cake. If those Shadows are all we have to worry about, this'll be a cinch.

text.Junpei: Wow ... I never knew I had that kinda power! We kicked some ass! But damn, I'm beat ...

text.Yukari: That's cuz you were bouncin' around like a little kid.

text.Junpei: You look pretty tired yourself, Yuka-tan.

text.Yukari: I'm still trying to catch my breath, actually ...

text.ACTION: (At first, as you explore Tartarus and fight Shadows your characters are likely to grow Tired fairly quickly. Tired characters do much more poorly in combat, will leave after you return to the entrance, and will get Sick if you keep forcing them to go on. This is bad news - Sick characters do even worse than Tired characters in combat and also only receive half healing from healing spells. If Minato gets Tired or Sick, his socializing and schoolwork suffer as well. As you spend more time in Tartarus, your characters' tolerance increases and you can go deeper without becoming Tired.)

text.Mitsuru: At this rate, they'll catch up to you in no time, Akihiko.

text.Akihiko: Heh. We'll see about that.

text.ACTION: Anyway, a little more happened, but I just spent the better part of an hour fighting the forces of evil by summoning The Bardinator. I'll write the rest of this entry later.
Coming up in the next entry: We finally start playing the damn game!
Music: Tranquility (This is the theme that plays while Minato runs around school.)

Sorry about the delay - things have been pretty busy lately, and for once I'm not talking about Shadows or related crap. You might have noticed that my journal's not friends-only anymore; turns out the others all have blogs, too, and they write about this stuff but nobody ever believes it. I guess it's no big deal if people think I'm crazy on the Internet, right? Also, everyone else friended me, but there wasn't any crazy Social Link action...lame.
Oh, turns out that I'd ended my last entry right around the point I wanted to, so I didn't forget to mention anything after all.
Anyway, at school the next day, I ran into this kid I remembered vaguely from class. Turns out his name is Kenji. I've gotten to know him a little better lately, he's a pretty cool guy.

text.Kenji: Man, I knew it. I heard from Junpei that you're pretty close with Yukari-san. ... What's up with that? Well, I guess it doesn't matter. I'm looking for someone with a little more experience anyway. By the way, I'm Kenji Tomochika. There's a morning assembly, so we better hurry.

text.ACTION: We weren't late to the assembly, which was a bad thing as the opening to those are boring as hell. Turns out I was glad I didn't miss it altogether, though.

text.Female Student: Next, we'll hear a word from the Student Council. Please welcome the new President, Mitsuru Kirijo, from Class 3-D.

text.Yukari: Well, I guess she IS the most popular girl in school.

text.Junpei: You can say that again! There's like some kinda aura around her ... besides, this school's owned by the Kirijo Group, right?

text.Yukari: Yeah, I try not to think about that.

text.Mitsuru: It is my firm belief that each of us must accept the responsibility of bettering our school. However, change cannot occur without sustained effort and an unprecedented level of commitment. That is why we must restructure our daily lives to accomplish this lofty goal. I'd like each of you to dig deeply into your well of motivation and re-evaluate your convictions ... to imagine a bold new future without losing sight of the realities around you. That is the key. I am certain many of you have your own visions for the future ... for us to reap the full benefits of our education, your participation, ideas, and enthusiasm are essential. Thank you.

text.Junpei: So ... do you have any idea what she just said?
Me neither ... we live in the same dorm, but it's like we're on different planets ... man, if she asks for my opinion, I don't know what I'll say ...

text.ACTION: School proceeded as usual after the assembly. I had Composition that day. Ms. Toriumi was going on about her favorite authors, as usual.

text.Ms. Toriumi: Oh ... hm, I don't really like this author. Okay, nevermind. I've got a great poem we can cover instead. Close your textbooks, everyone, and listen ... "Beneath the seas, high above in the skies ... "

text.ACTION: I thought about dozing off in class again, but I didn't. This was actually a really good idea, because...
...Ms. Toriumi is damn serious about her poetry.

text.Ms. Toriumi: You should be ashamed of yourself, taking a nap while I pour my heart into reading this poem! For that, you get another essay along with your regular assignment tonight! I'll expect a slice of cake when you turn it in, too!

text.ACTION: Dodged a bullet there...well, I guess it's pretty ironic for me to say that, huh?
I didn't have anything to do after school, so I was free to do as I pleased, but there really wasn't that much available yet. Being the new kid sucks.

(For the rest of the game, we have to learn how to best manage Minato's time. He can spend time socializing, studying, sitting around at the local cafe...all kinds of stuff. This will have consequences on his life, and in turn will have consequences on his performance in Tartarus. It'll be up to you guys what we have him do.)
I figured I'd chat with Junpei some, then take off and head back to the dorm.

text.Junpei: I heard no one was even close to her in the election. Considering her background, I don't know why they bothered. Let's face it, we're all just plain ordinary compared to her, man.

text.ACTION: I met another guy, too, but he seemed too busy thinking about workouts to talk.
On the way out, I met this chick. She kinda creeped me out...

text.Creepy Girl: Everyone else looks so small compared to Mitsuru-senpai. Oh, Mitsuru-senpai ...

text.ACTION: I backed away slowly and headed for the exit...
...after taking care of some business. Wait, why am I blogging about this?
I mean, it was great and all, but seriously. Ignore that, guys. Moving on...

(Being in Great condition is the opposite of being Tired - you hit more, do more damage, and deal more critical hits. It doesn't last very long, typically for around a day, but it's good stuff while you've got it.)
Oh, there's a vendor near the school's exit...
...who sells snacks and stuff. I wasn't really in the mood for anything, though. Also: five thousand Yen for a book cover? Give me a break.
I had just stepped outside when I heard a gaggle of girls freaking out over Akihiko.

text.Junpei: Have you noticed how popular Akihiko-san is with the ladies? Man, take a look at that ... I didn't use to talk to him much, but now I've got a good excuse. I know he's the captain of the boxing team, but ... who woulda thought he'd be such a chick magnet?! I mean, come on! You don't even see girls flock like that on TV! I wonder where they're going ...

text.ACTION: Well, at least being seen around Akihiko ought to do wonders for my image. He's pretty cool for a prep.

text.Junpei: Hell yeah! Whatcha got in mind?

text.Akihiko: I want the two of you to meet me at Paulownia Mall. You know where it is, right? I'll be at the police station. See ya there.

text.Junpei: Th-the police station?! You mean, we're not hangin' out with your friends ... ?

text.Akihiko: Who, these girls? I don't even know their names. They talk so much they give me a headache. Anyway, I'm gonna head out ... don't keep me waiting.

text.ACTION: He didn't even pay attention to them and they still swooned over him? Damn, maybe that "ladder theory" thing was right after all.

text.Junpei: Man, how can he not know their names?! I mean, seriously! Just look at them! ... Oh well, let's go.

text.ACTION: Here's a map of town. As you can see, the mall's pretty close to the school, so it didn't take us long to get there.
Once inside, we headed to the station as asked.
Akihiko was waiting for us inside.

text.Akihiko: Oh, these are the guys I was talking about earlier.
I was waiting for you guys. This is Officer Kurosawa. He helps keep our squad well-equipped. And this is from Ikutsuki-san ...

text.Junpei: R-really?! Sweet!

text.ACTION: Well, I can afford one of those book covers now, at least.

text.Akihiko: Officer Kurosawa has connections ... but these things still cost money.

text.Kurosawa: Of course they do. Nothing in life is free.

text.Akihiko: I realize that. Well, I'll see you later. Thanks again.

text.Kurosawa: My job is to maintain peace in the city, regardless of the circumstances. I'm just an ordinary police officer, but it doesn't take a genius to know something strange is going on here. I'm only doing what I think is right.

text.ACTION: He had a decent selection, I guess...but I have to admit that I haven't had any weapons training, so I didn't know what exactly to get. What I think I'm gonna do is ask all of you guys on the Internet what weapon I should use every so often. That way I can mix it up a little and learn something about each...variety's the spice of life, huh?
Oh, when I asked Kurosawa why he didn't carry guns, he pointed at the Evoker at my waist and asked if I really wanted to risk pulling out the wrong gun in battle.
I didn't. Swords and bows are fine by me.
We left after that, having not bought anything. Junpei was in a shitty mood, so he took off, and I took the chance to look around the mall and learn about the stores.
Club Escapade, for instance, is a nightclub that's only open at, well, night. I've gotta throw some scene gear on and stop by sometime.
Chagall Cafe is pretty busy most of the time, but they serve some sort of pheremone-laced coffee, which sounds pretty neat. (This raises Minato's Charm if we have him stay there in the afternoons.)
Accessories are sold here at the Be Blue V. They're really, really expensive, though, and I don't think I can count on the Chairman for any more monetary favors.
In the back of the mall, I found an entrance to the Velvet Room. I figured that, like the one in Tartarus, nobody but me could see this one either.

This is the Mandragora, a karaoke club. I'm actually a pretty big fan of karaoke...most people wouldn't guess that about me. (This raises Minato's Courage if we have him stay there in the afternoons.)
This antique store is closed, so I have no idea what it's all about.
This pharmacy sells medicine and such; I might have to stock up before our next trip into Tartarus, just in case.
This is a record store. I...legally obtain all my music, so there's no real need to shop here.

And finally an arcade. Video games aren't really my thing, though. After looking around the mall, I still had some time to kill and no homework to waste it on, so I headed down to the local shrine to take a look around.
It didn't seem all too special at first...
...though I did stop by to make a 1000-yen offering at the box.
I felt a little smarter having done so, believe it or not. Who knows why?
There was also a fortune container nearby. I went ahead and drew one...
Oh, and there was also 1000 yen inside the fortune for some reason. That ended up paying for my shrine offering, so I'm not complaining.
I ended up heading back to the mall and staying at the Mandragora for the rest of the day.
It was a pretty good time, and I ended up feeling more confident on the whole because of it. After that, it was getting late, so I headed back to the dorm.
Mitsuru was waiting for me when I got there.

text.Mitsuru: Regarding our exploration of Tartarus ... Akihiko is still on the mend, so for now, I'd like you to lead the team. You never know when a powerful enemy might appear, like the one you faced the other day. It's best to be prepared, or else you may find yourself in a difficult situation. So whenever you'd like to explore Tartarus, just let me know, and I'll gather everyone here. Also, since I'm sure there are other things you will need to take care of, you may go out at night if you need to. Well, that's it. Keep up the good work.

text.ACTION: According to Akihiko, Officer Kurosawa patrols at night, so he's not available at the Police Station. That means we can't buy equipment at night.
Junpei brought up a concern that I had myself. He's pretty much right. Maybe we're all nuts.
After heading back up to my room to get some rest, I decided I'd study for a bit.

(Studying is a free Academics boost at night, but can potentially make you Tired. it also doesn't help you recover from being Tired or Sick, and in fact doesn't tend to increase your Academics if you try, so it's best to go to bed early if you're feeling low.)
The next morning I ran into Kenji again.

text.Kenji: Dude, I thought the rumor about you and Yukari-san was true ... well, it's not like I care or anything. But you've sure had some bad luck since you transferred here. You know, dude, all the weird stuff that's been happening. How everyone's been saying they're hearing strange voices ... well, I guess since you're always listening to your headphones, you probably haven't heard anything.

text.ACTION: Hey, I can't help it if I'm really, really into Taking Back Sunday. Their music really speaks to me, okay?
After school, Kenji came by to say hi.

text.Kenji: No reason, really. I just don't have anything to do later and I thought we could finish our conversation from this morning. So whaddaya say, man? Let's get some ramen and talk.

text.ACTION: I decided I might as well...
...if only on the off chance I might gain occult powers from doing so.

text.Kenji: Whew! Now that's what I'm talkin' about! Well, was I right or what? This ramen tastes great, doesn't it? I bet they put a special ingredient in it ... something no other ramen shop uses. It's probably some sort of secret spice ... oh, sorry, my bad. I get all geeked up when I eat here.

text.ACTION: Well, the ramen WAS pretty good, so I agreed it was possible.

text.Kenji: Wow, you don't look like the type of guy I'd normally hang around with, but I guess looks aren't everything. By the way, man, I hear you and Yukari are close. Damn boy, you move fast! I mean, you just transferred here. I can't blame you, though. A man's gotta be aggressive nowadays.
We'll get some food and I'll tell you about my secret plan. Wait 'til you hear about it, dude. You're gonna flip!

text.ACTION: ...yup, I knew it. Cha-ching. Being nice to people is profitable!

(Social Links are built by establishing relationships with others. Each Social Link corresponds to one of the Major Arcana; likewise, each Persona and Shadow also corresponds to an Arcana. As you develop a Social Link by spending time with that person, it grows more powerful, and Personae of that Arcana become more powerful when you create them through Fusion. We'll go into this further later on, but long story short, if Minato was an antisocial sort of emo kid he wouldn't get very far.)
Before long, it had gotten dark, so Kenji and I parted ways and I headed back to the dorm.
Mitsuru was there waiting for me again.

text.Mitsuru: Exploring Tartarus can be exhausting, especially since you must do so late at night. You may find that you need a great deal of rest to recuperate. The others' conditions will vary as well, so make sure you take that into consideration before you begin exploring. If you want my evaluation of everyone's condition, don't hesitate to ask.

text.ACTION: I was exhausted, so I headed to bed after studying.

(When ascending Tartarus, it helps to spend some time levelling up on earlier floors and leaving when you grow Tired. Once you feel you're ready to handle an ascent, it's best to do so while avoiding Shadows as much as possible. It's possible to gradually make progress up the tower this way; if you kill everything every time you enter, you'll run into the problem an earlier poster mentioned, where you're always too Tired to do anything.)
On the way to school the next morning, I overheard another conversation.

text.Listener: Is it just me, or have there been more weird people around lately?

text.Gossip: You're talking about Apathy Syndrome, right? My neighbor has that ... she grosses me out. Sometimes I think I might have it too, and it depresses me.

text.Listener: Maybe you just need some exercise.

text.ACTION: Athletic teams, huh? Well, it's worth a thought.
After school, I ran into Kenji again. He wanted to go for ramen again today, so I decided I would join him.
At least my stupid Livejournal username is starting to make sense.

text.Kenji: So can you, like, go into Yukari-san's room and stuff? No, huh? That's what I thought. Well, I'm not interested in girls her age anyway. When it comes to women, I like them to be older than me. What about you?

text.ACTION: Well, I hadn't really thought about it, but I guess I wouldn't mind a girl a year or so older or younger than me.

text.Kenji: That's awesome. Good for you, man. Well, to tell you the truth, I ... wait, this is just between us, okay? I have my eye on someone. This is the "secret plan" I was talking about. I'm going to ask her out.

text.ACTION: ...Oh, for the love of.  First new friend I make here and he turns out to be a little pervert.
My life is a goddamn mess.

text.Kenji: Anyway, I want you to be there when I ask her out. But you gotta promise you won't tell anyone, okay?

text.ACTION: I didn't even do anything this time, he just confided his creepy plan to me! I mean, I'll take superpowers anywhere I can get them, but still...aiding and abetting pedophilia? Yay, I'm a criminal.
It was getting late, so soon after that we both took off. Thank God, I was getting kinda creeped out.

text.Junpei: He said you're a pretty cool guy. I've known him for a long time, even though we don't usually hang out. He's a good guy, and man ... he has no fear when it comes to the ladies.

text.ACTION: The next day, I ran into Kenji at lunch.

text.Kenji: You doing anything after school? If you're looking for something to do, come talk to me, man. I'll be at my desk. Well, I guess I should go study ... NOT! I mean, who needs to study, right? Hahaha ...

text.ACTION: Yeah, that's not suspicious at all. After class, I went to look around the school a bit more - I was interested in those athletic teams. Turns out there were there of them.
So anyway, guys, I'm left with a few decisions, and I want you to help me make them.
First off, what kind of weapon should I use? Right now, Kurosawa sells one-handed and two-handed swords, along with bows.

Also, how should I spend my spare time? Should I keep hanging out with Kenji? He's a little creepy, what with the teacher thing. I don't know if it's a good idea or not, so it's up to all of you Internet people. If so, should I do that often or...
...join one of the athletic teams instead? If so, which one? Should I do that often?
Finally, should I work on my Courage, Academics, or Charm? Maybe a little of all three?
(As mentioned previously, we will be putting this up for a vote. Feel free to share your opinions on what Minato should do.)
Coming up in the next entry: More Tartarus action, along with the results of your choices!
So I went ahead and decided to join the Track Team, just like you guys said. I may look scrawny and weak, but if there's one thing I'm good at, it's running away!

text.Yuko: You're a junior, right? Since we're the same year, you can just call me "Yuko".

text.Coach: This is the future captain of the team. He's a great runner and scores well in competitions. You two are in the same class, right? Kazushi, keep an eye on the new guy here, okay?

text.Kazushi: You got it. You're the guy who went out with Yukari Takeba on the first day of school, right? You're practically famous.

text.ACTION: Kazushi is...well, he's pretty heavily into track. In fact I'm not sure if he likes anything more.

text.Kazushi: Then, long story short: from now on, you're mine after school. Just because you joined mid-season, don't think I'll go easy on you!

text.ACTION: I can feel when this is coming now. It's kinda like a sneeze.
Social Links are like Pringles: they come in a tube and don't taste very good.

text.Yuko: I'll make sure your uniform is ready for next time.

text.ACTION: I checked out the track like she suggested, and after awhile it was time to head home.
Yukari greeted me this time, asking if I had joined any school clubs. I had...well, you just saw that.

text.Yukari: Oh yeah? That's cool. ... You seem pretty talented, so I'm not surprised. Oh, by the way, maybe we should go to Tartarus tonight. With all the Lost, I think we should be doing anything we can to help. Plus, I didn't have practice today, so I could use the exercise.

text.Mitsuru: Just don't take it lightly, okay? It's dangerous out there.

text.Yukari: I'm aware of that.

text.ACTION: This sounded like a pretty good plan to me, so I talked to Mitsuru and told her that I was ready to go.

text.Mitsuru: A few floors up, there's a barricade preventing you from going any higher. The tower seems to have a number of these interspersed amongst its floors. I know I told you that the layout changes each day, but these barriers seem to be in fixed locations. Therefore, I'd like you to try and reach the first barricade. I'm counting on you.

text.ACTION: Sadly, she didn't mention exactly how high up "a few floors" was. Looks like we'll just have to keep climbing until we reach the barricade.
As we entered the labyrinth, Mitsuru took the chance to warn us of a powerful enemy on a floor above us...
...but we had normal enemies to deal with on the way there, so we didn't concern ourselves with it too much.

Remember how Mitsuru mentioned she was able to Analyze the Shadows for us? I've started having her do that so I can make decent drawings of them. This guy right here is a Maya, the most common "breed" of Shadow. They're all over the place in Tartarus, and we found out later that they come in a number of different varieties.

(Each Persona and Shadow, as mentioned earlier, has an associated Arcana. This Cowardly Maya, for instance, is aligned with the Magician. Some weapons will have special properties enabling them to do more damage to enemies of a certain Arcana.)
One of the interesting things about Tartarus is that it's got briefcases full of money and items lying all over the place. Not much money and items, mind you, but it's free so I'm not complaining.
We continued up the tower, taking out Shadows as we went...
...such as this Merciless Maya. It's pretty similar to the other Cowardly Maya, but it's a little stronger and has different weaknesses.

Tiaras like this Muttering Tiara are Shadow spellcasters, basically. I found it's usually a good idea to take them out early on if possible, before they start slinging magic around like it's going out of style. That shit hurts.
On the fourth floor, Mitsuru warned us that we were nearing the powerful enemy she had mentioned earlier. We were doing pretty well, and I wasn't about to wuss out, so we went on.

I don't know if I mentioned this earlier, but every so often after defeating Shadows we'd be hit with this sudden surge of power. It felt kinda like that time I was at the front row of a Dashboard Confessional show. Awesome stuff, let me tell you.
(This is an RPG, so of course you level up as you kill enemies. Unlike most games, levelling up in Persona 3 only affects your character's maximum HP and SP, nothing else.

(However, experience Minato gains is also distributed to his current active Persona, which will also level up over time. Your statistics are based on those of your Persona; this doesn't mean much for any character but Minato, whose statistics and "class" can drastically change based on the Persona he's using. It's possible to change Minato's focus from magic to physical attacks to defense all in the space of a single battle by changing Personae.)
On the fifth floor, Mitsuru finally confirmed that it was time to throw down with the powerful Shadows she had mentioned earlier.

Before that, though, we ran into a strange device that looked kinda like the thing at the entrance. Turns out it's a teleportation device - how cool is that? I mean, it probably causes sterility or something, but my life is a goddamned mess as it is; I don't think something like that could make it much more of a mess.[/i]
After we activated the device, it was time to battle the powerful Shadows. I made an animation of the resulting fight:
Well, as you can see, we beat the Shadows...I guess that's obvious, otherwise I wouldn't be here writing about it. Junpei got hit pretty badly with a Wind blast during the fight, though...
...so he took off as soon as we got back to the entrance. I can't blame him, that looked like it hurt.

(Going into Tartarus with less than a full party is a risky idea, and is basically just asking for Minato to get his ass handed to him. It's better to take a break from Tartarus if you start losing members due to Tiredness or casualties in battle.)
The next day in class, I overheard another conversation.

text.Listener: Yeah, leave Iwotadai Station, go straight for awhile, and it's after you cross the crosswalk. We've been at this school for awhile ... you should explore more often!

text.ACTION: While I'm not a huge reader, that still sounded pretty interesting, so after school I took the monorail over to Iwatodai Station.
Following the gossiping students' directions, it was easy to find the bookstore.
Inside, I found an old man and woman taking care of the shop.
Is there anyone normal in this town?

text.Bunkichi: Hey, you're a student, aren't you? You must be from Gekkoukan High, right? That means you've probably seen the persimmon tree there ... do you think I'm making this up?! I'm serious! It was planted right beside a walkway in a courtyard at the school.

text.ACTION: Though I normally make it my perogative to ignore the ramblings of old men, particularly those who live in velvet elevators and have weird long noses, I thought this guy's persimmon tree story might have some weight to it. I decided I'd head back to school and take a look around, but before I left, I took a few minutes to look around the strip mall.
"Wild-duck Burger". I'm not going to think about this too hard. (This will raise Minato's Courage if he stays here after school.)
There was a ramen shop, too, and I guess I should keep it in mind since I'm apparently totally into ramen. Stupid username.
Sadly, it was too crowded for me to step inside.

Wakatsu claims to serve some kind of mind-enhancing sushi. I decided I wouldn't think about that too much, but it might be a good idea to drop by here before midterm exams. (This will increase Minato's Academics if he stays here after school. There are better ways to raise Academics, though.)
Along with a few other uninteresting stores, there was also a beef bowl shop, which was too crowded to check out.
With my exploration done, I decided to head back to school to look for that persimmon tree.
It turned out to be pretty easy to find.
I grabbed a leaf from the ground around the tree and took it with me before I headed back to Bookworms.
My life. Is a goddamn. Mess.
I let him see the leaf I brought with me, partially  because I was afraid he'd hurt me if I didn't.

text.Mitsuko: ... Wait, so you didn't come here to buy books? Did you come here just to show us this?

text.Bunkichi: I knew it! I knew right from the start that you're a kind young man! I've been meaning to go see that tree for a while now, but I'm not sure if these stumpy old legs will make it that far. ... That wasn't supposed to be a pun, you know. "Stumpy", "tree stump" ... catch my drift?
So, your name is Minako Arisato ... then, we'll call you Minako-chan from now on!

text.ACTION: All of a sudden, I felt a familiar sensation...
Social Links: it's what's for dinner.

text.Mitsuko: Come visit us if you get bored.

text.ACTION: After meeting Bunkichi and Mitsuko, I headed back to the dorm for the evening.
I kinda wanted to go to Tartarus, but Junpei still wasn't doing so hot from being airblasted earlier, so I decided it would be a better idea to just let him rest for now.
Right before going to bed, I got a cell phone call from Kenji.

text.Kenji: You have anything planned for tomorrow? Wanna get together?

text.ACTION: I didn't, so I decided I might as well, since Kenji seems to be pretty popular with you blog readers.

text.Kenji: Really? Cool! Alright then, tomorrow it is! Don't forget!

text.ACTION: Someone told me to study every night before bed unless I went to Tartarus, so that's what I did...
...meaning this particular aspect of my life being a goddamn mess is their fault. Thanks a bunch, StarkRavingMad. [/i]

(There's a chance that Minato will become Tired when studying...I guess the guy doesn't know when to take a break. If you try studying while Tired, there's a very high chance that it won't do anything but ensure you stay Tired.)
Despite my being tired, I had promised Kenji I'd hang out with him, so we met up at the mall and went to the record store.

text.Kenji: D'z is a great singer, and he looks so cool on stage!
Hmm ... .

text.ACTION: Oh, what, first it's To Catch A Predator, now it's Queer Eye For The Straight Guy? I went ahead and humored Kenji, though.

text.Kenji: You're pretty good looking to begin with, man, so if you work on how you dress, you'll be good to go. Then you can be my wingman!

text.ACTION: I had a feeling like that Social Link senation, but not quite as powerful. I think if I keep at it with Kenji, I can take our relationship to the (presumably horrifyingly creepy) next level.

(You can only upgrade a Social Link when your friend is ready to do so - this is indicated by a red exclamation point over their head at school. Situations like hanging out on the weekend allow you to get closer to your friend and speed the process along.)
I went to bed early that night, and ended up feeling much better the next morning.

I overheard a conversation about yet another assembly on the way into class. I just love these things.  What's worse, apparently it was just about the Principal feeling shown up after Mitsuru's awesome speech at the last assembly. She really needs to learn to underachieve like the rest of us.

text.Teacher: First, our principal has some words he'd like to share with you. Please give him a warm welcome.

text.Yukari: ... You think it's about the recent incidents?

text.Junpei: Who cares? The Principal doesn't know anything about the Shadows, anyway. I just hope this doesn't take too long ...

text.Yukari: I know. His speeches always drag ...

text.Principal: As you are aware, strange incidents have been reported on the news lately. It is my firm belief that none of you are involved. However, if we want to better our school, than we all need to accept responsibility for change. Dig deep down inside, and tap into your imaginations ... but don't lose touch with reality. As they say, "there's no use crying over spilt milk." That is the key to reaping all the benefits that school has to offer ...

text.ACTION: For a second there, I wanted to perforate my skull with something other than my Evoker.

text.Junpei: Yeah, you're right ... what's up with that?!

text.ACTION: All that just to try and show up the Student Council president. Give me a break...
At lunchtime, Mitsuru came to see me in class.

text.Mitsuru: I'm sorry, but I need to talk to you after school. I have a special request for you. I apologize for being in a rush, but I don't feel comfortable asking anyone else. I'll tell you more about it after school, okay? Au revoir.

text.ACTION: School proceeded as usual after that...
...and afterwards, Mitsuru came to see me again, just as she had promised.

text.Mitsuru: To make a long story short, I want you to join Student Council. It's not like you'd have to participate in every activity. Just come to the Student Council room when you have time. Being President is very time consuming. I'd like to have additional help available in the event of an emergency. You understand my situation ... I'm asking you because you know what it's like to be a leader.

text.ACTION: Well, if all I had to do was go to the meetings, Student Council didn't seem like it'd be that big of a deal. I told Mitsuru I'd do it.

text.Mitsuru: ... I've already made an appointment for you with the faculty adviser. You'll have to go to the Faculty Office on your own. I'm sorry I made the arrangements without your permission, but I hope you understand the position I'm in. Please go to the Faculty Office, Arisato. I'll be waiting for you in the Student Council room.

text.ACTION: So I headed down to the office...
...where I talked to Ms. Toriumi about Student Council. There was a lot of paperwork involved, so I'll glean over that part and we'll move on.
Redundant caption aside, I headed to the Student Council room after signing up.
Inside, Mitsuru introduced me to the rest of Student Council.

text.Mitsuru: He's the one I've been talking about the past few days. He'll be joining us in Student Council.

text.ACTION: This is Hidetoshi. He's...well, he's kind of a hardass, to be honest. I guess you'd have to be if you ran the Disciplinary Committee.
And this is Chihiro. I noticed she never made eye contact with me...I wonder if it had something to do with Kenji's "fashion tips".
I seemed to hit it off pretty well with everyone, at least...wait, hitting it off with someone means...
I'm starting to lose track of all these damn things.

text.Mitsuru: From now on you have my permission to enter the Student Council room whenever you need to. That includes after school, too. Thank you, Arisato, for joining us today.

text.ACTION: The meeting wrapped up, and we headed back to the dorm.
Thanks a ton, Junpei, where would I be without you?
And that's that. I need some more help now, though. You see all those Social Links I've got now? Well, here they are again, in case you're getting as mixed up as I am...
Hierophant: Bunkichi and Mitsuko, the bookstore properietors
Emperor: Hidetoshi, the head of the disciplinary committee
Which ones do you guys want me to work on? I'm getting short on time between school, Tartarus, and this, so a little help would be great.
(Hint:  Each of these will branch off into yet another Social Link as well. )
Coming up in the next entry: Things get even MORE complicated!

So it turns out that the next day after joining Student Council, I ran into Mitsuru on the way to school. She was wondering if I'd gotten used to life at Gekkoukan High yet, and to be honest I have for the most part. Sure, everyone is either weird or a Persona-user (also weird), but I guess it's not that bad.

text.Mitsuru: I see. Your ability to adapt to new situations and environments is very impressive. By the way, there's something I forgot to tell you. Most times you can find me in the lounge. However, I won't be there if there is something I must attend to.

text.ACTION: (This typically relates to plot events, but she can just arbitrarily not be there sometimes. You just have to find something else to do on those nights.)
At lunch, I ran into Kaz.

text.Kazushi: Wanna go for a jog before lunch is over?!

text.ACTION: I...didn't, really, so he took off. Sorry, Kaz.
I thought about going to Track after school, but...
...it looked like Kenji really wanted to talk to me, so I decided to see what was up with him instead.
Ugh, thanks for reminding me that my life is in fact a goddamn mess.
Yeah, you're only interested in 30-something teachers, you reverse pedophile. Kenji's weirdness aside, I figured it was better than killing myself running Track, so off we went to the ramen joint.
I figured he was sick of school, and said so.

text.Kenji: Dude, I've been sick of school since my first day freshman year. I mean, I wake up, come to school, listen to lameass lectures, come home, eat, watch TV, go to sleep ...
Thanks, dude! Soon I'll have a girlfriend, just like you!

text.ACTION: I wouldn't say that around Yukari if you wanna keep both testicles.

text.Kenji: Her name is Ms. Kanou. You don't know her, do you? She teaches 12th grade ethics. I'm totally acing her class.

text.ACTION: (Isn't Minato an 11th grader? Why's Kenji his classmate if he's in 12 grade ethics?)
Listening to this was probably as much fun as you think it was.

text.Kenji: Hey, man, don't tell anyone about this, okay? You're the only one who knows.

text.ACTION: Wait a second, he confided in me? That must mean...
...yup, it's time for Creepy Voices From Beyond, starring me.
The Surgeon General does not endorse Social Links.
I walked home with Kenji when we finished our ramen. He was going on about Ms. Kanou the entire way back. Lovely.
Mitsuru greeted me when I got back to the dorm that evening.

I didn't mention this, but all my previous entries were typed and pictures uploaded via wireless on my cell phone. I guess it's not a big deal either way, but it'll be nice to have a full-size keyboard again.
I'm not really much of a gamer, but that's mostly because I spend all my time on my art instead.

text.Junpei: You know, those games you play with a buncha people you never met before. I was totally addicted to this one game, but then I got burned out ... here, you can have it.

text.ACTION: Now why does that sound so familiar...

Speaking of Junpei, I had wanted to go to Tartarus that night, but he had diarrhea. I figured that wouldn't be very helpful for fighting off horrible creatures from beyond time and space, so we stayed home that night.
The next day was a holiday. The internet line was fixed, so I figured I'd give that MMORPG Junpei gave me a shot.[/i]

text.PHIL: When we accept that fact, our world becomes "reality". Reality is but a reflection of our thoughts and expectations. ... But what if we were merely reflections in another's mirror? Are you prepared to look through that mirror and discover the truth?

text.ACTION: Turns out it just dumped me ingame while I was in the middle of character creation. Stupid Korean MMOs.
I used to get pissed when people didn't type proper English, but it's so common online these days that worrying about that will only get you an ulcer.

text.Maya: oh wow, u haven't even finished generating your char yet ... o_O welcome to teh game! good thing i'm using my low level alt. i think its jus u an me, this is kind of a dead MMO these days xD

text.ACTION: Oh, thanks a lot, Junpei. "Here, dawg, play dis game wit nobody else on! Dur dur durr I am Stupei!" Ugh.

text.Maya: we r supposed to be our "alternate selves" rite? uhhh ... yeah. =/ sooo ... what r u gonna call ur char? we can meet up later. hm ... hey, i got a good name for u =3
