text.Mitsuru: Alright, let's split up and search for it. There's no time to lose; hurry!

text.Fuuka: Wait! Please, give me a moment! This is my responsibility ... !
Tell me, Lucia, what is this thing that deceives me ... ? Hear the wind's answer in your ear ... touch the earth's answer with your fingertips ... taste the water's answer on your lips ...

text.Akihiko: Hey, is she okay?

text.Mitsuru: Don't break her concentration ... .

text.Fuuka: Some kind of ... webbing?

text.Aigis: Perhaps it has something to do with the old power cables underground. They were just left there when the island's construction was completed.

text.Mitsuru: Power cables?

text.Aigis: Yes, they run underground in many directions, like a web.

text.Akihiko: And they're interfering with her ability?

text.Fuuka: ... Thank you, Aigis, I understand now.

text.Yukari: They what?! So ... it's underneath this whole area?!

text.Akihiko: ... Now it all makes sense.

text.Ken: H-how are we supposed to beat something like that?!

text.Shinjiro: Tch ...

text.Junpei: This isn't funny ...

text.ACTION: I have to admit that I wasn't surprised at all by this.

text.Chidori: I have some new orders for you to give to your friends ... surely you have the capacity to communicate with them.

text.Junpei: Me? Give orders?

text.Chidori: If you do as I say ... you won't be harmed.

text.Junpei: You want me to cancel the mission? ... You're not one of "them", are you?

text.Chidori: Quit wasting time.

text.ACTION: Back at the mall, we were trying to figure out how to deal with the Shadow possessing the electrical wires.

text.Fuuka: Just like that one, this Shadow must have its own body. Let me see if I can find it ...

text.Akihiko: Even if we know where it is, we might not be able to get to it ...

text.Aigis: There may still be a way to reach the structure that the cables feed into.

text.Shinjiro: We'll see.

text.Yukari: Fuuka ...

text.Fuuka: It's close by ... in this mall!

text.Yukari: In here?!

text.Fuuka: It's inside a small chamber underground. It's rectangular, so I assume it's man-made.

text.Ken: Is it some sort of room ... ?

text.Shinjiro: Wait a minute ... I overheard the manager of Escapade saying that the power's been acting up lately.

text.Yukari: That's no surprise ...

text.Fuuka: That's it!

text.Mitsuru: Good job, Yamagishi.

text.ACTION: I decided to bring Akihiko, Shinjiro, and Yukari along for this mission...
...and once they were ready to go, we were off.

Boss - Hermit (Hermit is one of the easier Ordeal bosses - he can zap the shit out of everyone with electricity, but not much else, and single-element bosses are easily cockblocked by Minato and his Persona-switching.)
It wasn't too tough to defeat the large Shadow.

text.Fuuka: Oh, and also ... I think I've found Junpei. He's back at the dorm, but something seems strange. The Chairman's there too, so he should be okay, but let's hurry just in case.

text.Junpei: Medea?

text.Chidori: ... My friend.

text.Junpei: Chidori ...

text.Chidori: Is it worth your life? Dying is what people fear most ... isn't it?

text.Junpei: Well, I've never actually given anyone orders before ... they wouldn't listen to me anyway.

text.Chidori: So you were lying earlier? Why? ... I don't understand.

text.Junpei: Us meeting, your wound, the picture ... were you just setting me up? Now that I think about it, that cut healed pretty quickly ...

text.Chidori: That was ...

text.ACTION: Right about then, we burst into the room.
When Chidori saw us, she drew an Evoker and brought it up under her chin.

text.Chidori: Medea, come ...

text.ACTION: Before she could pull the trigger, though, Junpei broke free and forced her to the ground.
As if things weren't chaotic enough, Ikutsuki decided to show up.
Akihiko did the smart thing and took Chidori's Evoker before she could do anything with it, thank God.

text.Fuuka: I ... I didn't sense her up until this very moment ... this is my only power, and yet ...

text.Ikutsuki: If even Fuuka couldn't sense her, then she must have some sort of power to conceal her presence. I didn't have the slightest clue she was here ...

text.ACTION: Mitsuru tried to interrogate her right away...
...but Chidori would have none of it.

text.Junpei: Ch-Chidori?!

text.Chidori: M-Medea, I'm ...

text.Mitsuru: Clearly, she's emotionally unstable. We'll let her rest and save our questions for later.

text.ACTION: And that's how the night ended. I wish those Strega guys would just give it up already...
...but they seem pretty desperate, so it looks like it'll be either them or us.
(Attack Fallen is great for Ken, since his main attack does a huge amount of bonus damage to enemies that are down.)
I don't wanna think about it too much now, though. I'm just gonna go to bed...I'll see you guys later.
Coming up in the next entry: Back to the grind once again!
Also, we need Social Link votes once more!
Emperor: Hidetoshi, head of the Disciplinary Committee
Hierophant: Bunkichi and Mitsuko, bookstore proprietors
Chariot: Kazushi, the Track Team member
Fortune: Keisuke, the art club leader
Hanged Man: Maiko, the grade schooler
School's back in full swing now, and all things considered it's not that bad. I missed hanging out with everyone over summer break, for one, and for two...
Anyway, current events in the life of Minato. Sunday morning, I had a vision of Mitsuru and the others trying to interrogate Chidori at the hospital.

text.Mitsuru: What kind of organization is Strega? Are there others besides you three?

text.ACTION: Suddenly, Junpei burst into the room.

text.Yukari: Uh ... sorry. He wouldn't stop bugging me about this place.

text.Junpei: How are you feeling? Seems like you've calmed down.

text.Mitsuru: She certainly has. In fact, she won't say a word. Maybe we should confiscate her sketchbook, too ...

text.Junpei: That won't make her talk!

text.Mitsuru: I'm not so sure about that. She was quite upset when we took her Evoker. Speaking of which ... where did you get that?

text.Chidori: Medea ... give it back to me! I want her back!!

text.Mitsuru: Then what am I supposed to do?! ... I'll have someone else try next time.

text.Akihiko: Yukari, call a nurse. We're done for today. I'll inform Ikutsuki-san of the difficulties we're having.

text.Junpei: Chidori ... what happened to you?

text.ACTION: After that vision, I went to hang out with the sick kid again. I'm glad whatever he's got isn't contagious, believe me.

text.Akinari: Thank you for coming ... it's better when I'm not alone. Why do I have to face this alone? ... Other people don't have to deal with this sickness.

text.ACTION: I know he's dying and all, and I don't meant to be disrespectful, but most of what this guy says could easily fit in an Evanescence album.
I told him that he wasn't the only one, though I knew it wouldn't be much consolation.

text.Akinari: ... But so what? That has nothing to do with my plight here in this bed. Where is there meaning in any of this?!
I wish I could run away ... but if my body was capable of that, I wouldn't be here anyway. No matter what I do, my body is there to remind me ... I'm going to die.
Please don't leave ... just yet ... when I'm alone it feels like it could end at any second.

text.ACTION: I told him that he doesn't need to worry...
...though I admit, I'm afraid of death too.
That's why I get so nervous before the full moon, y'know?
Either way, just talking to Akinari seemed to help him feel better.
That's really the best I can hope for...
...sad as that may be. I went back home after hanging out with Akinari...
...and went to Escapade that evening, where I ran into Mutatsu.

text.Mutatsu: Anyway, I'm sober today ... so just sit down and listen to what this old monk has to say. All I gotta do is look all serious and recite the sutras, and I can make easy money; at least, that's what I thought. So I begged to take over my parents' temple. But every day is the anniversary of someone's death! I'm workin' 24/7, as if my temple was a convenience store ...

It varies, of course, but an offering can sometimes be as much as a salary man's year-end bonus. But as you can see, I'm too busy. I gotta push this old body of mine to the limit. Maybe I should think of somethin' else to do with my life. I can't keep this up for much longer ... I've been drinkin' too much lately ... makin' a fool of myself like I did the other day. A person should know when enough is enough.
We never filed for divorce, and since I own the temple, we could all live there. I think it's a pretty good idea. I could retire and enjoy life for once. Whaddya think?

text.ACTION: I wasn't sure what exactly he meant...

text.Mutatsu: First, I gotta find out where they are. I'll hire a detective. I don't care how much it costs. And when I see 'em, first think I'm gonna do is tell 'em I'm sorry ... from the bottom of my heart. I'm gonna be concentratin' on this, so ... I probably won't be seein' ya anytime soon ... I-I've had enough of dealing with a punk like you, anyways! G-Good riddance!

text.ACTION: The old guy sounds like he's going to miss hanging out.
I hope things work out for him, too.

The next day was pretty uneventful; I spent it trying to become just a little bit more of a badass by watching old Happy Days reruns and acting like the Fonz. I've stopped studying at night because, well, there's nothing left to study; maybe I went a bit overboard over summer break.
On Tuesday, I had a vision of Mitsuru and the others still trying to coax Chidori into talking.

text.Mitsuru: By refusing to speak, you're only hurting yourself. We aren't keeping you here because we hate you; we just want to avoid unnecessary confrontation.

text.Junpei: Did she say anything? Can I just talk to her?

text.Mitsuru: Iori ... it seems like you're letting your emotions get the best of you. Is everything okay?

text.Junpei: Well ... not exactly ... I know she attacked me, but ... I can't stop thinking about her!
... You okay? I'm glad they let you keep your sketchbook. You really do like to draw, huh ... ?

text.Chidori: ... it doesn't matter.

text.Fuuka: She spoke ...

text.Chidori: No one else but me can understand my pictures ...

text.ACTION: As Chidori moved her hand, Junpei noticed that there was another deep wound in it.

text.Junpei: Why are you bleeding?!

text.Akihiko: I thought I had removed all the sharp objects in here ...

text.Mitsuru: Apparently, we can't leave her unattended for even one moment. But fortunately, she heals at an astounding rate.

text.Junpei: Then, at the station ... you did that to yourself?!

text.Chidori: ... I never asked for your help. You were the one who misunderstood.

text.Junpei: Well, I want you to stop. You can't be doing that ... it's not right ... and I won't let you!

text.Fuuka: Alright, let's go, Junpei-kun.

text.ACTION: Mitsuru and Akihiko kept at it all afternoon...
The next day was pretty nondescript, but at least I finally started feeling like the demonslaying asskicker I am.
All in all, I'm feeling pretty well rounded these days.
The day after that, Junpei and the others were at it again with Chidori.

text.Junpei: C'mon, cheer up ... I brought you a new sketchbook. I thought your old one might be getting full.

text.Chidori: ... That wasn't necessary, Junpei.

text.Junpei: Heheh, you said my name ... i was worried I'd never hear that again.

text.Mitsuru: She finally started talking, but nothing useful yet.

text.Akihiko: Well, that's a start. So why are YOU here?

text.ACTION: Suddenly, Chidori seemed to start choking on something.
The culprit appeared only briefly, but there was little doubt as to what it was...
Shinjiro quickly ran up and gave Chihiro some pills.

text.Junpei: Chidori!

text.Shinjiro: Relax ... it happens.

text.Mitsuru: Supressants ... ? You know about Strega?

text.Shinjiro: You'd be surprised what you can learn on the streets. I'll give the doc the right pills. The rest is up to you ...

text.ACTION: Shinjiro took off, and Akihiko went after him.

text.Junpei: Th-thank God ... ! I thought you might be ...

text.Chidori: Why do you look so scared? Death is nothing to be afraid of ...

text.Junpei: What are you saying ... ?

text.Chidori: Dying just means you don't wake up anymore ... that's all.

text.Junpei: Wh-what?! You don't really mean that, do you?

text.Chidori: Junpei ...

text.Junpei: Just because you're not afraid doesn't mean no one else is ... did you ever think about how I might feel?!

text.Chidori: Haha ...

text.Junpei: Ha ... look who's talkin' ...

text.ACTION: Akihiko caught up to Shinjiro at Port Island Station.

text.Akihiko: Why did you have those pills?! I've heard about those ... they're taken to suppress a Persona when the user can't control it. But the side-effects ... you're not taking them, are you?
Answer me!

text.Shinjiro: I don't owe you anything.

text.Akihiko: Tch ... the same as always.

text.Shinjiro: Save it. I've heard it all before. You think I'm wasting my power ... but you're just too thickheaded. I'm tired of your damn preaching.

text.ACTION: All of a sudden, Akihiko slugged Shinjiro in the face.

text.Akihiko: You know the reason ...
That's why I try so hard ... we promised, remember? To become strong enough to do what we think is right ... so why the drugs? Why didn't you come talk to me?

text.Shinjiro: I'm back in the fight now ... so let it go.

text.Akihiko: ... and the side effects?

text.Shinjiro: It's something only I can do.

text.Akihiko: Like what?

text.Shinjiro: ... Listen, don't worry about me. Just do what you think is right.

text.ACTION: I went to see Chihiro that afternoon, since we hadn't talked in awhile...
...and that evening, I got the standard call from Elizabeth.
Mitsuru told me that she was going to let Junpei handle Chidori for now, so she, Akihiko, and Fuuka would be around after school again to go to Tartarus.
The next day, I hung out with Bebe after school.

text.Bebe: I am worried about my uncle ... 'ow can I convince 'im to let me stay 'ere?

text.ACTION: I doubted the validity of that plan.

text.Bebe: ... Oh! Maybe if we go to ze Sweet Shop and 'ave a snack, I can come up wiz a plan! Shall we?!

text.ACTION: So that's just what we did.

text.Bebe: I will be disappointed if I 'ave to return to my country! I want to stay 'ere in Nihon even if I 'ave to eat dirt!

text.ACTION: I told him I was behind him all the way...
...and boy, am I glad he didn't misunderstand.

text.Bebe: Jitsu wa, actually ... I 'ave a plan! I will return 'ome ... mochiron, of course, I will not give up just like zat! I will come back 'ere after persuading my uncle! I will convince 'im 'ow great Japan eez! Now, I just 'ave to figure out 'ow to explain it to 'im. Zat will be easy with your 'elp, Minato-sama!

text.ACTION: Now how could I resist that face?
I mean, er, us guys gotta stick together!
Macho male bonding and all that!
That evening, I went to go see Mutatsu again, probably because he didn't give me butterflies when we talked like Bebe does.

text.Mutatsu: He said they're runnin' a small restaurant. I guess it's pretty popular. My son's married, and his wife's pregnant ... that makes me feel so old.

I won't be back until they've forgiven me. I'll get down on my knees if I hafta. And if my son wants to sock me in the face, well, that's fine too. I-I've been thinkin' about what I'm gonna say to my wife ... even though I'm not so good with words ...

text.ACTION: Well, that's terrible, and since it was Mutatsu I knew I could tell him so.

text.Mutatsu: But I finally faced the fact that I was drinkin' to hide my true feelings. I feel so free now.
You reminded me of my son. Maybe Buddha sent you to help me ... I gotta admit, I believe in fate. If I hadn't met you, I'd never have seen my family again. I owe ya, kid ...

text.ACTION: My life is still a goddamn mess...
...but at least someone else's is on the right track now.
(Chi You is a Chinese god of war.)

text.Mutatsu: When you mix Cointreasu with white rum, lemon juice, and ice ... you get a cocktail called "XYZ."
Plus, it tastes sooo good goin' down. I'll be prayin' that your future is XYZ ...

text.ACTION: With warm fuzzies in my heart, I headed back to the dorm for the evening.
The next day, I promptly slept through class due to being at the bar all night talking with a former drunkard monk. Whoops.
Junpei went to go see Chidori again after school.

text.Chidori: I wasn't expecting them to. That's why they started watching me in the first place.

text.Junpei: Oh, how's that cut doin'? Prolly already healed, huh ... so how come you're not drawing today?
Well, uh, not really ...

text.ACTION: Junpei noticed that the flowers sitting by Chidori's bed weren't doing so well.
Before he could move them, though, Chidori reached out and touched them, causing a surge of light to flow into them from her hand.

text.Chidori: ... I made them healthy again.

text.Junpei: You can do that?! That's incredible, Chidori!

text.Chidori: It's nothing special. You have powers too, don't you?

text.Junpei: Well, yeah, I guess ... but ...
WIthout that ... I'd be a nobody. I just talk a big game, pretendin' like I'm some kinda hero. But in reality ... I don't know what the hell I'm fighting for ... or why I'm here at all.

text.Chidori: Why ... why we are here?
What kind of dream?

text.Junpei: That one ady, I'd grow up to be a pro baseball player. Pretty stupid, huh? I guess that's part of bein' a kid.

text.Chidori: Is that so ... ? I don't remember much from my childhood. All I remember is being surrounded by white ...

text.Junpei: Huh?

text.Chidori: I hate hospitals ...

text.Junpei: Yeah, me too ... I'm sorry ...
Chidori ... I ... I understand. I won't let you down.

text.ACTION: That day after school, I went to go accept Fuuka's invitation to try her cooking.

text.Fuuka: I want you to taste the lunch I packed. To be honest, I don't have very much confidence in my cooking ... but today, I think it turned out okay.

text.ACTION: I was pretty sure my life was finally going to end, and not by being eaten by a Shadow...

...To my credit, I didn't puke-a all over Fuuka. But she did want me to be honest, so I told her it tasted like shit. Not even shit...fried shit that had been eaten by a skunk and then shat out again, then the skunk sprayed on it, then it was fried AGAIN and served to me.

text.Fuuka: I'm sorry I made you taste test my cooking ... but I know that you'll always be honest with me. I depend on you ...

text.ACTION: We went back to the dorm together, and that night, at the Dark Hour...

text.Pharos: Time goes by so quickly, and many things change. Yet some things will always remain the same ... don't you agree?

... That tower, for instance. I've been thinking about it lately ... I wonder ... will our relationship stay the same ... ? Or will it evolve? No matter what the future holds, you and I will be friends ... that is for certain.

text.ACTION: It's safe to say that he really creeps me out.
Oh well, he comes and goes as he pleases so it's not like there's much I can do about him.
Today, I went to go see Akinari again. It's turning into a weekly routine.

text.Akinari: I know it probably looked pretty bad last time, right? ... I had been reading a book before you came that day. I got so absorbed in the reading that I forgot to close the window, and I didn't realize how chilly it was.

I read a lot of books these days. I find that they're the easiest ways to spend my time, since I can get lost in a book's private world. Do you read books all the way to the end? I really get into the story and usually reach the end quickly, but ... I never want to finish it.
Stories about hope or heroism ... those're the kinds of books I read. So hopefully, if I do decide to finish reading them, I'll feel happy at the end when I come back here.

text.ACTION: ...it might be hypocritical to say this, but if I were in his position, I'd try harder to enjoy my last days. I wonder if I can explain that to him how...well, I guess I'll think about it later, but I'm going to bed for now. See ya everyone!
Coming up in the next entry: More school, more links, more everything! Maybe some Tartarus too.
Music:Radio Wazee for the most part

Y'know, I've got nothing against Igor. The guy's helpful with the whole Persona fusion thing and all, but I really wish he'd find a better way to contact me than putting me in a damn coma for several days.

Anyway, the past couple weeks have had their fair share of stuff happening. For one thing, I've been bringing Junpei along into Tartarus to bring him back up to speed with the rest of us; wouldn't want him to get rusty or anything.
I also gave him my old Spiked Bat. He was pretty much thrilled.
I also updated my stable of Personas. King Frost here isn't so much a mythological entity as he is a personification of pure awesome...
...Orthrus is a Shadow-eatin' dog, not unlike Koromaru...

...and Oumitsunu is a big statue that smashes things. One of Elizabeth's requests involved getting him to level 33, and that's what we spent the majority of this excursion doing; it wasn't easy, since Oumitsunu was only capable of using Kill Rush and Media, so I was stuck healing while everyone else did the fighting.
We saw some new Shadows, of course; this Jotun of Power didn't have weaknesses but DID have a tendency to explode when it was near death, so it wasn't much fun to fight.

We also had a lucky break in Tartarus - we found a Mage's Mark, which I immediately hoarded for myself, threatening to bite anyone who so much as looked at it. This accessory allows me to regenerate SP every turn in combat, so it's invaluable.

Junpei got better pretty quickly, too, even though he'd been out of action for awhile. (Party members who are a lower level than Minato get bonus experience in combat, meaning they level up very quickly and it's easy to make them useful again.)

We also opened the path to the next part of Tartarus, but we didn't proceed yet - I was saddled with a shitty Persona and Junpei was still rusty, so we saved it for next time. While we trained, a couple interesting things happened.
For instance, I learned a new Fusion:
Also, after some hard work, I managed to get Oumitsunu to the necessary level; when I brought him to Elizabeth, she rewarded me with a Machine Core.
After making Taraka as fusion fodder...
...I used the Machine Core to create Nata Taishi.

Nata Taishi's focused on physical attacks and is definitely no slacker with them, but his best trait is that he knows Masukukaja, which raises everyone's evade and hit rate. Group support skills like this are uncommon finds, so Nata's great to have around.
With Nata in tow, we did a little more exploring, and managed to take down another Rare Form:
To round out my new Persona set, I created Clotho, a magic-based Persona with lots of Wind skills. Before long, though, we wrapped it up and headed home.
The next day, everyone at school was abuzz about the upcoming Culture Festival...
...and a typhoon that was heading our way too.
After school that day, I headed to Port Island Station to talk to President Tanaka.

text.Tanaka: You should be glad you're such a handsome boy. Alright, let's add a new word to our vocabulary. Repeat after me!

A placebo is a "pretend" pill. Basically it's a medicine to ease your mind. Eliminate those unsightly lovehandles without lifting a finger! It's a miracle breakthrough that will make you feel fabulous! Enjoy a relaxing drive while taking in the beautiful scenery! Our incredible supplement will help you get the most out of life!

We may not be providing tangible benefits, but we do provide peace of mind. People will pay handsomely for that, you know. Take emergency supplies, for example ... people feel safe just because they have them, but it's merely a false sense of security.

text.ACTION: To be honest, Tanaka kinda creeps me out...
I guess it's not surprising given that his Arcana represents temptation, really.
The next day, I hung out with Bebe at Fashion Club.

text.Bebe: I 'ave come up wiz a great idea to show Japan's charm to my uncle! I will show 'im a kimono, and make 'im understand the beauty of Nihon!

text.ACTION: Well, that's as good an idea as any...

text.Bebe: Ze kimono eez a Japanese treasure! If I show it to my uncle, he will surely let me stay in Nihon. Ze design will be ze mascot of ze Sweet Shop!

text.ACTION: I haven't thought about it much...
...but if he really does go back, I'm gonna miss Bebe for sure.
There was more gossip on the way into school the next day.
As you can imagine, I was psyched for the festival at that point.
After school that day, I went to go sell the Supreme Coin I'd gotten from the Rare Form...
I held her hand for the first time that day, too!
She seemed to enjoy it, so things seem like they're going well.
While we walked together, though, a little kid ran into us.

text.Yuko: That kid lives across the street from me.

text.ACTION: Some more kids showed up after that.

text.Yuko: This is no place to be playing tag. It was okay this time, since it was me, but what if you had bumped into a stranger? Go play at the playground.

text.Boy: We can't play there ... there are sixth graders playing soccer ... they said they'll move if we beat them in a race, but we're only fourth graders! We can't win ... so we had to play tag here instead, Ms. Nishiwaki.

text.Yuko: Alright, come with me.

text.ACTION: Yuko and I took the kids to the Gekkoukan practice field.

text.Yuko: If you see any strangers, run away. And boys, make sure you protect the girls. Promise?
Practice until the big hand is on the 12, and don't touch anything around here. I'm gonna have a look around.
Pump your arms more and don't lift your legs so high, or you might pull a muscle. Give it a try! Believe in yourself!
It's worth it just to see the smiles on their faces ... but I've never been a coach before ... am I doing the right thing, Minato-kun?
I'll do it! I'll be your coach! But I'm not gonna go easy on you guys! And no one's allowed to quit, either! Got it?
Think positive! If you think you're gonna lose, you will! Don't be afraid of them just because they're sixth graders!

I'm sorry, I didn't mean to keep you so long, but is there any chance you'd be willing to help me train them? I only know a little bit about racing, and besides, you're pretty athletic. I'd be really grateful. Well? Will you help me? Pleeeease! I'll be lonely coaching them all by myself ...

text.ACTION: Wow, she really depends on me.
We really do seem to be getting somewhere!
And that's a pretty good sign, too.
The next day, everyone was still abuzz about the typhoon. It seemed like the Festival was gonna be cancelled, which sucked. No Yukari in a maid outfit.
I went to see the old folks that afternoon...
...and was promptly drenched on the way back. Ugh.
I wasn't feeling too great after that, believe me.

text.Fuuka: According to the news, a typhoon just hit. Supposedly, it's the biggest one on record. It's moving slowly, too, so it'll be around for awhile.

text.Junpei: Yeah, thanks to that, the school festival got canned. Well, setting all that stuff up is a pain, so I don't mind, but it sucks that we'll be stuck indoors.

text.ACTION: I have to admit, I forgot we even had a break from school.

text.Junpei: What about you, Fuuka?

text.Fuuka: Me? The only thing I plan to do is go to the movies ...

text.Junpei: Oh, a movie? Is it a date ... ?

text.Fuuka: It-it's not like that! I'm going with Natsuki-chan. She absolutely loves movies ... but with this typhoon, I don't know if we'll be able to go.

text.Junpei: How 'bout you, Yuka-tan? Will ya still have practice?

text.Yukari: ... I doubt it. The archery range is outside, so it's most likely canceled until the storm blows over.

text.Akihiko: Same here. This stupid typhoon is gonna mess up my training.

text.Junpei: What about you, Senpai?

text.Mitsuru: I haven't decided. Besides, what business is it of yours, Iori?

text.Aigis: I suspect that you will be visiting Chidori-san. Although she has stabilized, we cannot release her.

text.Junpei: Man, Ai-chan, you must be psychic. And ya know what? She WANTS me to come! Not to brag or anything ... I, um ... just thought I should check up on her. Ya know, with the storm and all.

text.Fuuka: Umm ... well ... oh, yeah! Ken-kun, what are you going to do during the break?

text.Junpei: Come on, you have to be doing something.

text.Ken: Well, I'll probably go visit the shrine.

text.Junpei: Dude, you're a kid, not an old man.

text.Ken: But that's where I always go ...
Anyway, I'm going back to my room. I have a lot of homework to do ...

text.Junpei: Oh, okay. call me if you get stuck.

text.ACTION: I decided to head off to bed too...
...because as Fuuka pointed out, I had started to feel like shit.
...and that night, during the Dark Hour...
...I found myself in the Velvet Room.

text.Igor: Several seasons have come and gone since I first offered my assistance. Now then, your special power, Persona ... I trust you've been using it wisely?
But it would be a pity to lose one such as yourself unnecessarily ... therefore, please allow me to provide you with a new form of assistance.

text.ACTION: (Normal fusion involves using two Personas to make a new one; the Persona that results depends on the Arcana and level of the two used. Sacrifice, or triangle, fusion is similar, but uses three Personas. Up until now we've only had those available; now we can use Cross and Pentagram Fusion. Unlike the original two methods, these use specific Personas in fusion to create a specific Persona, so there's no trial and error involved - you have a list of Personas you need to make a certain Persona, and that's it. Some of the most powerful Personas, and most of the max Social Link ones for that matter, are made this way.)
Little did I know that while I'd only spent a couple minutes in the Velvet Room, three days had passed in the real world. I really hate it when that happens.
On the bright side, the typhoon had passed during my rest, and I didn't seem to be sick anymore.
Not to mention it was a holiday.
Since it was Respect for the Aged Day, I went to go see Bunkichi and Mitsuko.
Mitsuko was in tears when I got there, though.

text.Bunkichi: She always cries at happy events, like the day we first met! All the graduates from my son's class have gathered at the school. They're collecting signiatures to save the persimmon tree!

text.Mitsuko: They say the tree is a memorial to their former teacher ... they don't want it to be cut down.

text.Bunkichi: It's been so many years, but they still remember him ...

text.Mitsuko: They've given their precious time ... for our son ... I-I don't know what to say ...

text.Bunkichi: Minato-chan, were you the one who called them all?

text.ACTION: Well, no, but I figured there's no reason to make them wonder.

text.Bunkichi: From the first time I saw you, Minato-chan, I knew you were different from the kids around here. You "da man", Minato-chan! Incredible ...

text.ACTION: Wait, first Junpei, now these guys?
I dunno, I really don't think I'm "da man"...

text.Bunkichi: Someday, I'd like to go have a drink together ... but let's wait until you're legal.

text.ACTION: He gave me a tasty soda (Cielo Mist - it's da best, mon!), and I headed home.
The next day, I hung out with Mamoru at the Beef Bowl Shop.

text.Mamoru: Think I should buy some for them, too? My siblings, I mean. I've got four of 'em! Our apartment's pretty small, though, so we have to pack 'em deep, haha. You won't believe how hot it gets over the summer.
I guess his car fell off a cliff ... I'm not fishing for sympathy or anything, I just thought you should know.

text.ACTION: He doesn't seem to be too bothered by his family situation...
...he's stronger than I am, that's for sure. I still can't stand talking about you-know-what.
The next day was another holiday...
So I went to see the old folks again.

text.Bunkichi: Who do you think it was? Here's a hint: "signature."

text.ACTION: Well, obviously it was the leader of the Bunkichi Fan Club! I heard he goes by the handle "GruntyThirst" on the 'net...

text.Bunkichi: Yeah, I wish! Actually, it was one of the organizers of the campaign to save the persimmon tree. He said "Let's protect the tree together!" AND he's gotten a lot of signatures from students who were in our son's class.
Of course! He was our proud son!

text.Mitsuko: I'm sure he's just as happy as we are ...

text.Bunkichi: Alright! Minato-chan, let's go to Gekkoukan right now! I have to tell my son the good news! I've never been so excited about a walk before!

text.ACTION: Well, the school was kinda closed...
...so we didn't actually go, but it's the thought that counts.
I came back again the next day.

text.Bunkichi: I know, I know! I just forgot to write down the second one.

text.Mitsuko: I feel bad for Minato-chan and all the people who've been campaigning to save the tree ...

text.Bunkichi: Oh, speak of the devil! I'm writing a letter ... something I haven't done in ages. But I can't remember how to spell half these words! Am I finally losing it? I used to have an amazing vocabulary.

text.ACTION: I asked what the letter was about...

text.Mitsuko: I'll tell you when the time comes, Minato-chan.

text.Bunkichi: Well, aren't you curious?
Lately, I even feel smarter! Maybe I should go back to school ... just kidding!

text.ACTION: I had no idea what was up with the letter...
...but I figured I'd find out soon enough.
After a couple uneventful days, it turns out that's exactly what happened today.
The sound of my footsteps as I walked in woke him up.

text.Bunkichi: Or were you just eager to see my pretty face?
Even though it's the middle of the day, I feel so sleepy ... well, since Mitsuko is here too, I think it's time we told you.

Sorry that we did it without asking you. Recently, I went to visit the persimmon tree, and I met a student on the way back. He told me that the school is planning to build a new addition. It would be selfish of an old man like me to deprive those young people of new learning opportunities ... I think it'd make our son happy, too, since he was a teacher. Helping those kids is more important than hanging in to his memory.
We're hoping, as we believe our son in Heaven is too, that more kind students like you will graduate from Gekkoukan. ... Please take this.

text.ACTION: Wow, the very first fruit from the tree they worked so hard to save...
...but I think I understand why they did what they did.
And I think it was the right thing to do for everyone involved. I'm glad I was a part of it.
(Kohryu is a powerful guardian dragon from Chinese mythology that fans of Nocturne and Digital Devil Saga might recognize.)

text.Bunkichi: Our son would want us to be happy ... I'm sure he's smiling down on us from Heaven.

text.Mitsuko: It's difficult having such a well-respected son. Oh, does it sound like I'm boasting?

text.ACTION: And that's that for the persimmon tree saga. I think the old folks will be fine for now, and I'm glad I could help them, but for now I'm gonna help myself to bed. Later, guys!
Coming up in the next entry: Action and/or adventure! And Social Links!

(Alright guys, time to vote again since we've maxed the old folks. This time, though, there's a catch. Choose from Chihiro, Fuuka, Yukari, and Yuko, since we may only seriously work on one of those at a time if we don't want shitty things to happen and waste our precious time. Here's the list.)
Emperor: Hidetoshi, head of the Disciplinary Committee
Hierophant: Bunkichi and Mitsuko, bookstore proprietors
Chariot: Kazushi, the Track Team member
Fortune: Keisuke, the art club leader
Hanged Man: Maiko, the grade schooler
Music: I'm trying a little Nightwish this time to see if it chills me out.
Unfortunately, the music thing isn't working as far as chilling me out before the Ordeal goes, so instead it looks like I'm blogging once again. I seriously think I'm addicted or something...
Anyway, after I wrote last time, we ended up going to Tartarus.
Before I even went in, I did my first Cross Fusion, combining the various members of the Frost family with Queen Mab...
...to produce Black Frost, who is fucking badass.

His main strength is his resistance to both Ice and Fire, but he's also got a great variety of attack skills and inherited Recarm, so he's nice to fall back on. Also, he's motherfucking Black Frost. Just look at him.
I also made a few filler Personas for fusion fodder and to fill out the Compedium; Loa, for instance...
Oh, when I showed Elizabeth Black Frost, she was so awed that she gave me a Wizard's Mark for free. That's how awesome he is.
Anyway, up we went into the fourth block, Tziah...

This one's new; the Tranquil Idol liked to use Hama skills to instantly kill us, which was a serious problem for me since I was using Black Frost. I switched Personas as soon as possible when we ran into them.
These Hakurou Mushas were samurai-like Shadows that had an annoying tendency to dodge physical attacks. Mudo worked like a charm on them, though.
There was also a Shadow shaped like a tank, of all things. They looked scary, but Zio skills and All-Out Attacks worked great on them, and they didn't roam in packs.
Constancy Relics are pretty nondescript, though Junpei had a field day with them thanks to their weakness to Fire.

I had trouble getting a good look at these Blue Sigils; they were surrounded by a rotating cube of paper that obsured our vision and make it difficult to target them. They were only dangerous to Akihiko, though, since they only had Ice skills.
Elegant Mothers were kind of disturbing, but fortunately they were easy to take out, too.
Before long, we got to the next Guardian...

Tartarus Boss 12 - Arcane Turrets (These guys aren't too tough; they're weak to Ice, unlike standard Arcane Turrets who are weak to Electricity, so a few shots of Bufu and some All-Out Attacks will make short work of them.)

After we brought down the Turrets, we kept on going up. I'd taken up using a bludgeon like Shinjiro; I like to think I'm pretty good with it, but it's not like it takes a lot of practice to learn how to squash things.
I also made a few more Personas; Saki Mitama was a support-centered Persona that'd come in handy later...
Parvati learned another of those handy mass support skills, too.
Rangda focused on debilitating skills, which really wasn't that handy...
...but fused well into Ananta, who was better able to utilize those skills and gave me a nice strength boost besides.
Nandi wasn't really intended for combat; instead, I made him to relate better to Mamoru when we hung out.
Even Fuuka learned some new skills - Healing Wave kept us going by restoring some HP and SP every time we changed floors.
We ran into another Guardian a few floors up...

Tartarus Boss 13 - Sleeping Table (This one, on the other hand, is a massive pain in the ass. It does a ton of damage with Maragidyne and Megidola, and without Mediarahan to heal up you're basically screwed. This means I had to grind for awhile before facing it; this is one of the few bosses where it helps.)
...and after that, we reached the top of the currently open area and found the sixth Old Document.
Everyone was beat after that, so we wrapped it up for the night.
The next day was a Sunday, so I went to go see Akinari.

text.Akinari: I thought I'd be fine since I have many nights when I'm unable to sleep because of my illness, but ... I guess my condition won't improve if I keep taking chances. I came all this way because I was hoping to find you ... remember how I talked about reading upbeat stories?

The problem is, all those stories were written for someone else. I guess what I'm saying is selfish, but I'm being selfish about you, too. You're always coming to see me, and I take up a lot of your time ... how much of your valuable time have you used on visiting me?

text.ACTION: Nice to hear I'm a light in this guy's life...
...he really doesn't seem to have much else.
I'm glad I met him just because of that.
That night, you-know-who showed up again.

text.Pharos: I hope nothing serious happens. But who knows what the future will bring ... so be careful. Remember, I'm always watching you ... we'll meet again.

text.ACTION: I hung out with Mamoru the next afternoon, but it didn't go anywhere...
...and a couple days after that, I hung out with Mamoru again.

text.Mamoru: Yum ... oh man, just a few more. This is kind of just what I do ... I like to eat pretty fast.
That was pretty fast compared to my record. Anyways, Minato ...

We really didn't have the money. But then I hear about a chance at a scholarship ... do you see now why it's such a big deal? If I win, I might be able to go to college after all! I bet my mother would be really relieved.

text.ACTION: I told him it sounded like a good plan...

text.Mamoru: If he was still around, my brothers wouldn't have to worry about whether or not they'd get to eat every day. ... well, complaining isn't going to accomplish anything! I'll just have to hope for that reccomendation.

text.ACTION: Wow, and I thought I was dedicated when it came to fighting Shadows...
...I guess we've all got our own stuff to deal with.
Speaking of dealing with stuff, I have to deal with sorting out my feelings for Bebe at some point before he leaves. Ugh.
I mean my totally platonic feelings for him, of course.

text.Bebe: Hm, so far so good, ne? Right? When my uncle sees zis, I know he'll agree wiz me about how great Nihon eez!
Arigatou! Zank you!

text.ACTION: Yup, all that macho sewing is totally building up my pecs.
Even Mitsuru won't be able to resist me before long, yeah baby!
Anyway, today Ms. Toriumi reminded us all about the exams that were coming up (ugh)...
...and I hung out with Yuko after school. I have to admit I was pretty distracted...
...because tomorrow's another of those nights, and I don't have anything left to blog about to take my mind off it, not to mention this music's starting to drive me nuts.
Coming up in the next entry: The sixth Ordeal, and...
...we went searching for Shadows like we usually do.

text.Fuuka: It's in the plaza in front of Iwatodai Station!

text.Ikutsuki: This will be the 10th ... only a few left, but let's worry about them one at a time.

text.Yukari: Assuming they come out one at a time ... just kidding!
Are you serious?! Me and my big mouth ...

text.Akihiko: Where's Shinji?

text.Fuuka: He just notified me that he'll meet up with you later. I didn't ask any questions.

text.Akihiko: Figures. he's always played by his own rules.

text.Junpei: It's okay. At least he's coming, right?
Hello? I was tied up, remember?! Sheesh, give a guy a break.

text.Yukari: Wait, Ken-kun isn't here, either. Hey Junpei, go get him. That'll be your punishment for last time.

text.Junpei: Punishment ... ? What is this, kindergarten?

text.ACTION: Junpei went off to look for Ken...
They weren't too hard to find.

text.Yukari: This is the way we go to school! We've gotta protect this place ...

text.Fuuka: It seems like they've been waiting for us.

text.ACTION: Junpei returned, but Ken was nowhere to be found.

text.Akihiko: Dammit, Shinji ... where are you?

text.Fuuka: Um, I think we should hurry ... they look like they're about to make their move.

text.Mitsuru: Alright, let's decide on a team and engage the enemy!

text.ACTION: I took Junpei, Akihiko, and Yukari, and we went into battle...

Boss - Fortune and Strength (Note that this video is around half an hour long - this fight takes THAT long. This is the Desert Bus of bosses. You can only target Strength at first, and it has a ton of HP that you need to whittle down while Fortune uses an irritating gimmick attack called Wheel of Fortune which peppers you with damage, debuffs, and status effects. Sometimes Wheel of Fortune will affect the enemies instead, but tihs isn't really something you can count on. Once Strength is dead, you have to deal with Fortune as it continues to spam Wheel of Fortune. All in all, while this might not be the most difficult battle in the game, it's easily the most painful.)
It took awhile, but eventually we won out.

text.Aigis: This time, those two who call themselves Strega did not interfere.

text.Yukari: It must be because we have Chidori. Anyway, I'm glad everything went well, but what happened to Shinjiro and Ken?

text.Fuuka: The Chairman doesn't seem to be too concerned, so he went home.
I'm sorry, I haven't been able to locate them yet.

text.Mitsuru: Let's return to the dorm and then go from there ...
Akihiko, are you listening?

text.Yukari: Senpai ... ? What's wrong?

text.Mitsuru: Akihiko ... ?

text.ACTION: I blanked out. That happens to me when things I might not want to remember happen, but this time I saw it all, and I wish I hadn't. Shinjiro and Ken had met at the Port Island hangout.

text.Ken: ... Do you know why I asked you to meet me here? Two years ago today ... October 4th.
They called it an accident, but it wasn't. I saw the whole thing ...
... Since then, it's been one bad thing after another. And all I get from people is sympathy, no matter where I go. ... What's the point in living?
You said once that you wanted to forget what happened on that day, so when I knew it was a full moon today, I knew I had to confront you. Today, Mom is watching over me.

text.ACTION: I found myself at the dorm...

text.Junpei: Anyway, why was Akihiko-san acting so weird? What's so special about October 4th?

text.Mitsuru: I was so caught up in the operation that I didn't realize it ... this is the day Amada's mother was killed!

text.Junpei: You serious?!

text.Mitsuru: Yamagishi, I need you to find the two of them immediately. There's a good chance that they're together. Akihiko must have already realized that ...

text.Fuuka: I-I understand.

text.Yukari: Umm ... what's going on?

text.Mitsuru: It was two years ago, when we were pursuing an unusual Shadow that had escaped into the city ... we were in a residential area, but the Shadow was all we were thinking about.

text.Junpei: No way ... are you shittin' me?!

text.Yukari: Then, to Ken-kun, Senpai is ...

text.Mitsuru: Amada volunteered to join us. But now that I think about it ...

text.Fuuka: They're together, and another Persona-user is nearby ...

text.Mitsuru: Akihiko?

text.Fuuka: No, it's ...

text.Junpei: That's not good.

text.Mitsuru: Ugh, it's an absolute nightmare!

text.ACTION: We all rushed for the station as quickly as we could, but I blanked out again...

text.Shinjiro: You're right ... I wanted to forget. That's why I left the group and tried to suppress my power ... but nothing I did could erase the memory. And now I find myself here - the last place I want to be.
It's my fault ... this is what I deserve.
Just remember that ...

text.Ken: Is that supposed to change my mind ... ?

text.Shinjiro: Even if all you have now is hatred, one day you'll regret it.

text.ACTION: Suddenly, a familiar voice rang out.

text.Takaya: That is the nature of revenge. Is it not permissible to kill those who are themselves killers?
The loss of Chidori has posed a bit of a challenge for us ... but we cannot simply ignore your meddling.

text.ACTION: Takaya drew and cocked his revolver.

text.Takaya: You cannot defy fate ... you shall die, whether or not it is at the hand of this boy.
You don't have much longer.

text.Ken: What's he talking about?!

text.Shinjiro: That's bullshit!

text.Ken: What does he mean ... ? You're going to die ... ? No matter what I do?

text.Takaya: The cause of death is not of importance. Besides, the breath of life is faint in you as well, child.
A slight change in timing shouldn't matter too much.

Now then ... with what life you have left, answer me this ... there is one like Chidori among you, is there not? This has enabled you to locate and defeat those we wish to protect. Now tell me ... which one of you is it?

text.Shinjiro: Th-there's no one ...

text.Ken: Wait!

text.Takaya: Is that true?

text.Ken: ... Yes. That's the only reason they let me join.

text.Shinjiro: Ken ... no!

text.ACTION: Takaya kicked Shinjiro in the face, knocking him to the ground.

text.Ken: It doesn't matter anymore ... I'll never have my revenge. I have no reason to live ...

text.ACTION: Takaya aimed his revoler at Ken, preparing to send him to his death...
I don't even know what to think anymore. Everything is such a goddamn fucking mess.
Coming up in the next entry: The aftermath...
Music: Nine Inch Nails - Ghosts I-IV
It's been a few weeks since Shinjiro died, and everyone's still bummed, myself included.
The day after it happened sucked ass.
Not only did we have to go to school after Shinji died, we had to attend the school's pathetic excuse for a memorial service. It was almost insulting.

text.Principal: He had a lifetime of opportunity ahead of him ... as educators, we are to blame for ignoring his silent calls for help. We lost him to violence before we had a chance to help him realize his true potential ... forgive us. Forgive us for our negligence ...

text.Senior (Front): I don't even know who this Aragaki guy was ...

text.Senior (Side): I heard he never came to school. ... Prolly just some punk. Anyway, I gotta get home ... I have to study for my mock-exam. ...

text.Senior (Front): Hey, you guys know who Aragaki is? Wait, you're not seniors, so how would you know? Anyway, can you believe this? Scary, huh?

text.Ms. Toriumi: Iori, sit down! ... I'll never heard the end of this.

text.Junpei: Tch ...

text.Yukari: Just ignore them, Junpei ... hey, have you seen Akihiko-senpai today? He was absent this morning ... I wonder if he'll show up at all. I hope he's okay ...

text.ACTION: Mitsuru came to class during lunch and told us about a meeting we'd have that night, though none of us was really surprised by it - something had to be done about Ken.
I blanked after school that day and had a vision as usual. Akihiko went to visit Shinjiro's memorial.

text.Akihiko: I had the usual for lunch ... ramen tastes a lot better when you're cutting class. Make sure you invite me next time ...
Why are you always like that? You're so stubborn. Put yourself in my shoes for a change ...
I guess you're right ... I was too obsessed with power ... ever since I lost Miki, that's all I've cared about. I thought that if I was strong enough, I could protect anyone ...
But I was so focused on fighting that I didn't notice anything else! It didn't matter how tough I was! Look what happened!
... yeah, I know ... crying won't change anything, will it? Alright, Shinji ...

text.ACTION: Akihiko stood up a new man...
...and he was ready to finish what we'd started.
Even his Persona evolved, reflecting the newfound power in his heart.
With that, Akihiko headed back to the dorm.
As for me, I went to hang out with Mamoru that day.

text.Mamoru: Yeah, just ... need more training ... let's go in, yeah? I'm thirsty!

I used to come here a lot with my teammates, but ... they wouldn't come now, even if I invited them. I don't really get along with people who don't take the club seriously. It jacks up practice, y'know? It's a lack of concentration. I used to love it there ... I spent all my time practicing in Track Team ... everyone else in Track Team and I always had so much fun.
I'll just have to surpass them. Get even better than I am now ...

text.ACTION: He's a lot more dedicated to Track Team than I am...
...I don't think I'll mention that to him, though.
That night, we had our meeting.

text.Mitsuru: We need to discuss how to deal with Amada ... I've already consulted the Chairman. Aigis, bring Amada here.

text.Fuuka: It's my fault ... when Shinjiro-senpai told me he'd be late, I thought it was strange, but I said nothing. If only I'd listened to my intuition ...

text.Yukari: Don't be so hard on yourself, Fuuka.

text.Mitsuru: It's not your fault. If anyone should have realized it, it should have been me.

text.Junpei: I knew this wasn't a game, but I never thought it'd end up like this ...

text.Akihiko: Shinji's last words were, "This is how it should be." He was a hell of a guy ... he even faced death head on. That's why, from this day forward, I'll face things head on too.

text.Junpei: That's cool, man ...

text.Yukari: Senpai ...

text.ACTION: Aigis couldn't find Ken, which presented a problem.

text.Yukari: He's not?!

text.Aigis: There are indications that the window has been pried open.

text.Yukari: Wait, Fuuka! Do you know where he is?

text.Fuuka: Well, no, but we can't just let him go off his own, right?!

text.Yukari: So where do you plan on looking?

text.Fuuka: I don't know, but we have to find him! He must feel so alone ...

text.Yukari: Fuuka ...

text.Akihiko: Let Ken do what he wants. Bringing him back won't change anything, and we can't keep treating him like a kid.

text.Mitsuru: Akihiko ...

text.Akihiko: It's his choice. He's the only one who can decide how he's going to live his life. The same goes for all of us ...

text.ACTION: After school the next day, I hung out with Mamoru...
...and that evening, Elizabeth called to tell me that more of Tartarus had opened up. I didn't feel ready to go just yet, though...
I also had another vision that evening - this one was of Ken at the Port Island hideout.

text.Ken: To this day, it's still on file as an unexplained accident. That's why I wanted to make it clear ... I thought that's what she would have wanted. Maybe then she'd finally be at peace ...
And once again, I'll be left behind ...

text.Akihiko: The dead are never coming back. You have to accept that. You're on your own now ...
I'm not here to drag you back. You can stay in this place until you die, if that's what you want.

text.ACTION: Akihiko walked off, leaving Ken to his thoughts.

text.Ken: I've known it all along; I've just been lying to myself. I was consumed by hatred ... I couldn't face the thought of being alone ... but that's exactly what happened ...
... I've made up my mind.

text.ACTION: Ken reached a resolution, just as Akihiko had...
...and again, his Persona evolved to reflect that.

text.Mitsuru: Yes, it has.

text.Junpei: So where's Akihiko-san?

text.Fuuka: He said to leave Ken-kun alone, but I don't know. Maybe we should look for him ... I can't wait any longer! I'm going right now to--
Thank goodness ... I was so worried ...

text.Ken: You were?

text.Mitsuru: Amada ... are you able to fight?

text.Ken: Yes. ... I won't run off again.

text.Junpei: You sure?

text.Ken: I'm positive.

text.Fuuka: It's alright ... we can trust him ...

text.Yukari: ... Geez, don't make us worry like that, okay?

text.Mitsuru: Alright, I'll talk to the Chairman. Get some rest.

text.ACTION: Aigis mentioned that she had noticed Ken and Akihiko's Personas evolving, and that it may happen to the others as well.
That night, Pharos paid me a visit.

text.Pharos: Can you believe it's already autumn? It'll be winter before you know it. You seem tired. Did something happen?

text.ACTION: I told him what had happened to Shinjiro.

text.Pharos: Until recently, this was the same to me as the blowing of the wind. But now I see things differently ... for the first time, I have a friend.
It's drawing near. Don't you sense it ... ? We are kindred spirits, you and I, so why is it that only I can remember? This is a heartrending matter ...
Forgive me if I have said anything peculiar today. ... Perhaps it is the change of seasons. Of course, our friendship remains steadfast. Well, I shall bid you farewell for now. Goodnight ...

text.ACTION: "The Fall"? I've never heard of it before.
I guess it must be what we're fighting to prevent by defeating the Shadows.
The next day, I hung out with Mamoru again.
I ended up waiting for a good fifteen minutes or so before he called my cell.

text.Mamoru: I just feel bad, since I'm the one who asked you to hang out ... but actually my mother passed out.
I guess she fainted from exhaustion, since she works from morning through the night ... this is my fault! ... But it's true! Look at all the trouble I cause her ... what?!
Dammit! Why can't I do anything?! ... Look, I'm sorry about today. I didn't mean to cause even more trouble. But at least you answered your phone ... and talking kinda helped. A little.

text.ACTION: Ugh, his life's already hard enough...
...he doesn't need anything else happening to him.

That night, I had Fuuka tell me about Akihiko and Ken's new Personas. Polydeuces had evolved into Ceasar, for instance, giving Akihiko access to more powerful lightning attacks, better healing, and mass support skills.
Nemesis had become Kala-Nemi, a goddess of time with more powerful healing, attack, and light skills.
The next day, I went to see Mamoru once again.
We went to the shrine to talk.

text.Mamoru: I just left from the hospital. I still have to pick my sister up from preschool, go shopping, cook dinner, do the laundry ... I've got so much I have to do. This is the kind of stuff Mom had to do every single day.

Even with the scholarship, I don't think we can afford college. I mean, what about living expenses? My family can't even pay their own ... just like Dad, now Mom can't earn any money either ... I'm gonna have to support them. I don't have any choice but to give up on Track Team ...

text.ACTION: I told him not to give up - there's always hope as long as you keep trying.

text.Mamoru: I'm going to take part in the meet! I devoted a lot of my life to Track Team. I'm going to take all that experience, apply what I learned, and achieve victory! I'm glad we could talk, I feel a lot better about things now. Thanks to you, I have a goal to aim for.

text.ACTION: So even if he competes and wins...
...he still won't be able to go to college? That's horrible.
I felt like he needed some support, so we hung out again the next day.

text.Mamoru: Think I should bring some home? ... Wait, I don't have any more money. Oh, by the way, about my mom ... she gets to come home from the hospital soon! Hopefully I can help her a bit more, since I finally got the hang of taking care of everyone.

One of 'em offered to pick up my sis from preschool. Everybody's been worried about me. I mean, I thought I was the only one who cared, and I ended up ignoring everyone else there. And after all that, it was probably my fault nobody seemed focused on winning.

This is just great. I mean, i already totally loved it. Oops, guess I kinda started rambling there ... I gotta run. And don't forget ... I can focus on training again cause you've got my back! So thanks, buddy.

text.ACTION: It's good to hear that things are looking up for him...
...but I hope there's no sudden downturns or anything.
I hung out with him again the next day.
After that was a Sunday, so I went to see Akinari.

text.Akinari: He was born in the calm forest of green, but he turned out to be pink. He's so visible that he can't hunt for food easily, so he's always especially hungry. The other animals dislike him and consider his coloration disgusting, almost like he's cursed. So he started living alone, but then he made a friend.

So the bird would stand on the pink alligator's back and practice its flying. It's embarassing to talk about, but I'm writing it for myself, so that's what matters. Maybe I'll be able to show you the entire novel someday.

I wanted to write an upbeat story of my own to cheer me up. Maybe if I can find some meaning to life, I can put that in my story. When I write ... I can see you in my mind. It seems as if you're telling me not to die just yet ...

text.ACTION: Well of course I don't want him to die just yet.
Preferably he'd never die at all...
...but it just doesn't look that way...ugh. Poor Akinari.
The next day was a holiday...
so I went to go hang out with Mamoru again.

text.Mamoru: I got first place, of course! This maens my sports career might be over for real. Makes me feel a little empty, you know?

I'm going to earn enough money to support my family. i think that's my responsibility now ... got one picked out and everything! My father had connections at a car factory, so I'll apply there. Thing is, it's pretty far away.
I always blamed school or my family for everything. I didn't want to face the fact that I was responsible. I really lucked out, y'know? If we hadn't met, I'd still be a jerk. I won't forget you.

text.ACTION: It struck me that I kept on losing friends left and right...
They were a piece of cake...
I saw Mamoru for the last time this afternoon.

text.Mamoru: My mother started crying, and she kinda blamed herself, but I want to support them. This is a new beginning in my life. It won't be easy to leave this ramen, though ... best in town. Hey, I gotta go ...

text.ACTION: We went out to the station together so Mamoru could catch his train.

text.Mamoru: Sometimes I get pretty pissed that he's not around anymore. My lfie wouldn't have had to be so complicated, y'know? I could've enjoyed Track Team more ... could've been a normal kid. But blaming Dad like that, it's just another way to run away from my problems.
As long as you have the key, I'll be able to stand on my own two feet, so next time we meet I can still be proud of myself.

text.ACTION: His life hadn't turned out the way he'd planned...
...but he's going to make the best of it. I respect that.
(Lucifer is a powerful archangel who led a rebellion against God and fell from Heaven. Many Christians now equate him with Satan.)

With that, Mamoru shook my hand one last time, and left. I went home too, and now here I am writing. Shinjiro, Mamoru...wonder what'll happen if everyone leaves. It's pretty depressing, actually...I think I'd rather go to bed than think about it anymore. Bye, guys.
Coming up in the next entry: Tartarus and Social Links!
(Mamoru and exams are both done, so we need new Links! Vote away.)
Emperor: Hidetoshi, head of the Disciplinary Committee
Hierophant: Bunkichi and Mitsuko, bookstore proprietors
Chariot: Kazushi, the Track Team member
Fortune: Keisuke, the art club leader
Hanged Man: Maiko, the grade schooler
Music: MCR. I'm trying to ease the pain with rock and roll.
Well...Shinjiro's still dead, Mamoru's still gone, and I'm still losing friends at an astounding rate. My life is a goddamn mess.
For instance, Akinari's still slowly dying of his genetic disease.

text.Akinari: This was the alligator's first friend, and he was very happy. They started going to the river every day, and the little bird would sing while the alligator listened. But again, the alligator couldn't catch food easily because of his color. Pink is such an odd color, his prey in the jungle saw him from far away and had plenty of time to escape. He became so hungry that he was dizzy most of the time ... and he accidentally ate the bird one afternoon as it slept in his mouth.

He drank swamp water to induce vomiting, but the bird was already dead when he retrieved it. After that, he couldn't bring himself to eat anything. That's as far as I've written. I haven't decided on an ending.
That was a lie. I was writing my will. I couldn't face reality, and I was essentially screaming curses into my notebook. But for now, I'm writing my story in the same notebook.
When it's done, I want you to read it. I mean, meeting you is the main reason I started writing it.

text.ACTION: I found myself wondering how long Akinari had left.
I also wonder if he'll be able to finish his story before then...
The next day, we found out how we did on our exams.
I wasn't all too surprised by how I did, to be honest...
...and that afternoon I went to go see President Tanaka.

text.Tanaka: If you put all your money in the bank, your modest gains will be offset by outrageous fees! Don't let the fear of bankruptcy dissuade you! You have to be aggressive in the management of your assets!

Since our scales have been skyrocketing, we decided to sell shares. And guess what? The number of shareholders skyrocketed too. Listen, this is the funny part ... the majority of our shareholders are also our customers! They keep buying more of our products, so of course the stock will rise! Isn't that hysterical?! You should learn to appreciate the irony.

text.ACTION: Does he realize I'm walking around with around seven hundred grand by looting a horrible monster dungeon?
...And I get the feeling it's probably best if he continues to not know.
The next day, I slept through class and had a vision as I did so...

text.Natsuki: Talk to me. Tell me what's bothering you.

text.Fuuka: It's about Aragaki-senpai ...

text.Natsuki: Oh ... pretty shocking, huh? I've never seen him at school, but I've seen him around town ... I wonder if he really did get caught up in some kind of crime.

text.Fuuka: Some things you can never get back ... I know that, from all the things that have happened with my parents. I've sort of been avoiding the question, but is it okay for me to go on like this?

text.Natsuki: Parents, huh ... ? I can relate to that. But you'll be okay, right?
Yeah, yeah.

text.Mr. Ekoda: Don't you want to give your classmates a proper goodbye?

text.Fuuka: Huh? What's going on?
WHAT?!

text.ACTION: At lunchtime, I was still snoozin' away, apparently...Fuuka and Natsuki had went up to the rooftop.

text.Fuuka: You're transferring ... and you didn't say anything?

text.Natsuki: It's not like telling you would've changed anything. Why make us both depressed? Anyway, my dad's pretty sick and they say it'll take some time for him to recover ... we don't really have that much money, so we can't afford to stay here. Y'know, I still think you're crazy for being friends with someone ilke me ... but like I said before, we're both in the same boat.
That's why I was so jealous when you moved into the dorm.

text.Fuuka: Natsuki-chan ...

text.Natsuki: But Fuuka, your house is nearby and your parents are pretty normal. So why'd you move?

text.Fuuka: Huh? Well, um ...

text.Natsuki: If you don't wanna tell me, that's okay. But if it's something that you and your folks can work out, then do it while you have the chance. It'll be awhile before my dad's in any condition for us to have a heart-to-heart.

Y'know, Fuuka ... I used to think that every day was just the same. And I'm only saying this because it's you, but you don't get any second chances in life. If you accept the way things are, then they'll never change.
I won't be in school next week 'cause I'll be packing, so I guess this is goodbye.

text.Fuuka: No!!

text.Natsuki: Haha, it's okay. Everything will be alright. C'mon, don't gimme that look ...

text.Fuuka: But ...

text.Natsuki: Hey, I'm not helpless, y'know. I've changed a lot since I met you. I'm gonna try and figure out what I really want now, and I hope you do the same.

text.Fuuka: I used to try and please everyone ... I was afraid of not being liked, so I did my best to fit in, but I never really thought about what I wanted.

text.Natsuki: Hahaha. That is so like you, Fuuka. Well I say if they don't accept you for who you are, then screw 'em. But I like you ... even if you don't like yourself.

text.Fuuka: Natsuki-chan ...

text.ACTION: Natsuki walked off, leaving Fuuka alone on the roof.
All of a sudden, she got a text message.

text.Fuuka: Natsuki-chan ... "Even if we're apart, we'll still be connected." It all makes sense now ... I've always been so worried about how others are feeling ... that's why my power allows me to stay connected with them. I guess there is something I want after all ... it makes me happy to see everyone else happy, too.

text.ACTION: ...and just as with Akihiko and Ken...
...her Persona recognized this, and responded in kind.
The others had woke me up by then, and we'd all went to the roof together.

text.Aigis: It is surprising to find you on the rooftop.

text.Junpei: Nah, we were just wondering what you were up to.

text.Fuuka: Everything's okay now.

text.ACTION: Everyone acts a little weird after having a life-changing experience, I guess.

text.Junpei: Uh, are you sure you're alright?

text.ACTION: I hung out with Bebe that day after school...
and checked out Fuuka's new Persona that evening. Lucia had become Juno, gaining...well, more of the same stuff, really. (For a laugh, note Fuuka's atrocious battle stats.)
I went to Fashion Club again the next day...
...and the day after that found Yukari acting strangely.

(This is a bad situation called a Reverse, and it happens when you ignore a Link for too long. When a Link is Reversed, you need to spend a day hanging out with that person to fix it; until you do, you don't gain the power boost for Personas of their Arcana that you usually do. This is also the reason we don't date more than one girl at a time.)
Since something had apparently crawled up her ass, I went to go get my gift from the Chairman for acing exams...
There was more Fashion Club the next day.

text.Bebe: Hmm ... zat cheap material 'as been transformed! Wizout your 'elp I would probably be back 'ome already ... but because of you, Minato-sama, I was able to finish zis kimono! Arigatou! Zank you for your kind words! I can forget about my aches and pains now!
I 'ave met many people in Nihon, but you are ze best tomodachi I 'ave 'ere! If my aunt was still alive, I would tell her about ze wonderful friend I 'ave made ... subarashii!

text.ACTION: The time was drawing closer and closer...
...and it was becoming painfully obvious that Bebe would be leaving soon. It hurt.

text.Bebe: I am so tired zat I zink I see my aunt! Zis is ze last part ... I can't give up! Ready, set ... GO!

text.ACTION: I didn't show Bebe how sad I was; instead, I went home to rest.
The next day I had another vision; this one featured Yukari and Mitsuru.

text.Yukari: Yes. The teacher asked for a report ...

text.Mitsuru: I see. Then you must be busy.

text.Yukari: Um, not really ... at least not compared to you. ... I wanted to ask you something. Senpai ... why did you decide to fight?

text.Mitsuru: Well, I ... I guess you could say it's my way of atoning for the past.

text.Yukari: I see. Well, in my case, I don't really have a reason anymore, if I'm being honest.
But I was thinking maybe I could erase the mistakes he left behind ...
I guess I should've thought about this earlier, huh? Why didn't I question myself sooner?
But it seems like everyone has their own reason for fighting ... in the end, defeating the Shadows is all that really matters, isn't it?

text.Mitsuru: What are you trying to say?

text.Yukari: I'm not exactly sure ... it'll all be over after the next full moon, but I'll probably still be trying to figure it out.

text.Mitsuru: Maybe so, but at least then we'll be able to return to a normal school life.

text.Yukari: No, that's okay. Thanks for listening.

text.ACTION: I hung out with Yuko that day...
...and the next was a Sunday, so I went to see Akinari at the shrine.

text.Akinari: It's calming down. Thanks.
I know, I know ... it's only speeding things along, but ... my medicine makes me drowsy, and if my hands go numb, then I can't write anything. I have to finish my story.

I get lost in my writing ... erase it ... and then don't know where to go next. When we're talking, I have a clearer picture. I can almost see it ... it seems like that might be the meaning of life for me.
Well, if I do find it and finish the story, I hope we get a little more time together after that.

text.ACTION: I hope we do too, now that I think about it.
All I can hope for now is that he holds on as long as he can.
The next day I went to see Tanaka again.

text.Tanaka: Oops, I forgot. You're underage. If you're curious, go ask one of your friends ... but not a girl, unless you want to get slapped. Our company has introduced a special filter for digital cameras. Simply attach it to your camera and voila! Start peeping!

It's been selling like hotcakes! In fact, it's our number one seller! Unfortunately, customers have been complaining that it doesn't work. I told my employees to just ignore them. Nowhere does it guaruntee that you'll be able to see anything, and it's not like anyone would actually admit they bought one.

text.ACTION: The things I do for supernatural demonslaying powers.
I went to Fashion Club the next day...
...and that night, during the Dark Hour...

text.Pharos: At last, the 12th one. Are you ready?
But it's a bit soon to be reminiscing.
Be careful now ...

text.ACTION: More Fashion Club the next day...

text.Bebe: I 'ave no complaints! When my uncle sees zis, he will surely let me come back to Nihon! It eez time for 'im to concede! I must 'urry up and go see 'im!

text.ACTION: I admit I teared up a little bit, but I held together like a real man.

text.Bebe: I will not give in to my uncle! ... Minato-sama ...
I made it from ze leftover material. It eez a sign of our friendship! Onegaishimasu ... please ...

text.ACTION: I told him I would, no matter how long it took...
...and that I'd expect to see him again one day.
We shared a good, macho cry together. It was very tough and gritty.
You'd have thought we were pumping iron.
And I know already that I'll never forget Bebe...
(Byakko is one of the Four Symbols, a group of Chinese constellations that represent the four cardinal directions. Byakko is the White Tiger and represents the West.)
...because he taught me what it means to be a real man.
I'm going to go cry myself to sleep now.
Coming up in the next entry: Less talk, more fight!
Tomorrow is it. We're finally going to bring down the last of the Shadows and end this nightmare for good. And you know what? I'm not going to miss any of this.
For instance, I'm definitely not going to miss the Dark Hour...

...or going to Tartarus, because nearly getting killed on a biweekly basis isn't nearly as fun as it sounds. Also, I've already gotten enough money out of this place to pay for my first year of college, so there's that. Normal jobs tend to be a lot safer, anyway.

Anyway, enough whining from me. We continued our climb up Tartarus to prepare for the operation; the last Shadow is bound to be desperate, and we'd need all the help we can get. We ran into new Shadows on the way up, as always; this Death Seeker had some kind of optical illusion going on, so we couldn't see it except as a bunch of floating eyeballs. Kinda gross, not to mention it was a fan of Mudo and the like, so we tried to take them out quickly.

On the other hand, these Flowing Sands are probably the most pathetic Shadows we've run into yet - any physical attacks will knock them down, and All-Out Attacks simply wreck them. I don't think I've seen one get a chance to attack yet.
This Mighty Cyclops could do some serious damage of a variety of elements, but fortunately it was easy enough to knock it down with a fire attack so it wouldn't get a chance to do anything.

Speaking of new stuff, Akihiko got to try out his new Persona for the first time during this expedition. Ceasar's Zio attacks are absolutely brutal, especially since I'd given Akihiko some Electricity-boosting Indra Bracers earlier.

And as long as I'm on the topic of new Personas, a trip to the Velvet Room left me with quite a few as well; my selection had been getting a little outdated, so this was a good thing. Cu Chulainn has a decent mix of physical and Electric attacks, along with Power Charge, which doubles physical attack damage.
Dominion didn't turn out to be useful as anything more than fusion fodder, since I hadn't advanced the Justice link very far.

There's not much to say about Kingu. It does have one extremely useful skill though - Virus Breath, which cuts enemies' health by a quarter. It's surprisingly accurate, and even works on some Guardians.
Kikuri-Hime has a variety of magical skills, making her great in all kinds of situations.
Lakshmi is from the Empress Arcana, one of the two that I still haven't established a Link for yet. She's powerful enough without it, though, having inherited some group support skills and Mediarama.
I also used a Cross Fusion to make Girimehkala. I'm sure he has his high points, but mostly I made him to fulfill one of Elizabeth's requests.

(Nebiros is fucking hardcore. Since we've maxed the Hermit Arcana, he gained all his skills immediately upon Fusion. This means he started with Evil Smile, which inflicts Fear on all enemies, and Ghastly Wail, which instantly kills all Afraid enemies, no questions asked. On top of that, he also has Fear Boost and Stagnant Air, which both increase the chance that Evil Smile will scare enemies. What this basically means is that given three turns it's possible to wipe out any normal Shadows - one for Stagnant Air to weaken the enemies' resistance to Fear, one to scare them all with Evil Smile, and one to finish them with Ghastly Wail. Sure, there's more efficient ways of dealing with them, but this is always a great backup plan.)
(Here's an example of that in action.)

Fuuka kept picking up new abilities as well - her latest one is called Oracle. It does...uh...something; honestly we still haven't figured out what it does. Sometimes it'll heal us, sometimes it'll blast the enemies, sometimes it'll heal or blast both us and the enemies. It's kind of a last resort.
Anyway, after some climbing we made it to the next Guardian...
Tartarus Boss 14 - Hell Knights (These guys are easily the most difficult Tartarus boss in the game. Just watch and you'll understand why.)
Everyone was beat after that, so we headed home for the night.
On Saturday, I went and hung out with Yuko.

text.Yuko: Repeat after me: "I can win!"
Don't give in to fear!
The winner will get to use the playground. They asked me to write a formal challenge for them, but I'm a little worried ... not just about the race, but also about my spelling.
They'll be fine, right?! After all, they learned from us!

text.ACTION: ...I wouldn't let any older kids beat my pint-sized minions in a race. I've taught them how to gnaw at ankles. They're unstoppable.
The next day was a Sunday, so I went to see Akinari again.

text.Akinari: So much for the hospital, right? Now I'm just waiting for the end, but I don't feel like I'm the only one being singled out anymore.
But once the time comes, it's the same for us all. I'm still a little lonely, but I'm not sad anymore.

text.ACTION: ...and I knew he didn't have long.
This might not be our last day together, but...he didn't have much left.
I can't say I didn't cry a little that night...
...though exhaustion from another Tartarus trip might've contributed to that, too. We fought another Guardian while we were there...

Tartarus Boss 15 - Mythical Gigas (This guy likes to use support skills to weaken the team before decimating you with powerful physical attacks. However, with support skills of your own, it's easy to counteract that kind of thing and make him a piece of cake.)

After that, get this: we reached the top of Tartarus! There wasn't a blocked path or anything, it was just...empty. To be honest I'm not even sure it's really the top, which is why I'm not gonna make a big deal about it until we know for sure. I doubt the real top would be so anticlimactic.
Well, except for another Old Document.
This afternoon, I tried to make up with Yukari...
...but she's pretty pissed, so it didn't work out.
I don't think she's happy with the whole Yuko thing...ugh, like I need anything else to worry about.
On the bright side, Fuuka will still hang out with me!
On the not-so-bright side, she keeps trying to make me eat her food.

text.Fuuka: I think it'll taste better than last time ... at least, it can't be any worse, right?

text.ACTION: Well, it wasn't squirming, so that was a good sign.
All of a sudden, a stray cat showed up.

text.Fuuka: He looks hungry, doesn't he? Here, kitty kitty ... maybe I should give him some food.

text.ACTION: Fuuka gave the cat some of the lunch she'd made...
